---
title: "Chapter 5 — Direct targets of Trh/Tgo and convergence with Ribbon"
author: "Yermek Aiten"
output: html_document
---

Direct targets of the Trh/Tgo heterodimer (Chapter 5). The `ch5-bootstrap` chunk
rebuilds the Trh/Tgo joint peak set (614 peaks) from the two IDR peak files, so
this file needs no objects from the Chapter 3 or Chapter 4 analyses.

- The direct-target set is the intersection of genes near Trh/Tgo peaks with the
  genes differentially expressed after *trh* RNAi in the modERN RNA-seq data of
  Fisher et al. (Table S43).
- The in-house *trh* RNAi microarray (FlyChip) is compared with that RNA-seq by
  genome-wide rank concordance and direction-validated subsets.
- The direct-target set is compared with the published Ribbon direct targets
  (Loganathan et al. 2016), and with the GSE28780 expression data (Chung et al. 2011).

Inputs are read from `data/final_peaks/`, `data/chapter5/` and
`data/reference_gene_lists/`; tables are written to `data/chapter5/`, figures to
`results/figures/`, and the values quoted in the text to
`results/reported_values.tsv` (final chunk).

```{r ch5-bootstrap, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ============================================================
#  CHAPTER 5 SELF-CONTAINED BOOTSTRAP
#  Defines: PROJECT_DIR, good_chr, FIGURES_DIR, fmt_p,
#           Trh_Tgo_joint_filt (614 peaks, rebuilt from raw narrowPeak)
#  No objects from Chapter 3 or Chapter 4 are required in memory.
# ============================================================

# ---- 1. Project paths ----
# Everything is derived from PROJECT_DIR.
## Repository root: the environment variable PROJECT_DIR, or the working directory.
PROJECT_DIR <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PROJECT_DIR", unset = "."), mustWork = TRUE)
if (!file.exists(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "README.md")))
  stop("PROJECT_DIR does not point at the repository root: ", PROJECT_DIR)

DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data")
CH5_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "chapter5")

## Values quoted in the dissertation are kept in results/reported_values.tsv
## (columns section, name, value). Writing a name that is already there
## replaces its value, so scripts can be re-run singly and in any order.
VALUES_FILE <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "reported_values.tsv")
save_values <- function(section, values) {
  dir.create(dirname(VALUES_FILE), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tab <- if (file.exists(VALUES_FILE)) {
    read.delim(VALUES_FILE, colClasses = "character", quote = "", comment.char = "")
  } else {
    data.frame(section = character(), name = character(), value = character())
  }
  for (nm in names(values)) {
    v   <- gsub("[\t\r\n]+", " ", paste(as.character(values[[nm]]), collapse = " "))
    tab <- tab[tab$name != nm, , drop = FALSE]
    tab <- rbind(tab, data.frame(section = section, name = nm, value = v))
  }
  tab <- tab[order(tab$section, tab$name), , drop = FALSE]
  write.table(tab, VALUES_FILE, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("%d values written to %s\n", length(values), VALUES_FILE))
}


## Colours
PAL_INK <- c(
  outline    = "#333333",   # bar and Venn outlines
  gridline   = "#DDDDDD",
  annotation = "#666666",   # p-values, n = counts
  threshold  = "#882255",   # significance thresholds, +/-1.96 lines
  fit        = "#4477AA",   # fitted / OLS trend lines
  neutral    = "#BBBBBB",   # non-significant, background sets
  band       = "#EDEDED",   # shaded stage/facet bands and strip backgrounds
  highlight_band = "#4477AA", # tint marking an agreement region (used at low alpha)
  emphasis   = "#CC3311",   # the one highlighted subset in an otherwise neutral plot
## Ink for stars printed on filled marks (Ch4 4x2 matrix, Fig 4.9); distinct from `annotation`, which sits on the white panel.
## Black (#000000) chosen: worst-case WCAG contrast 4.34 across PAL_DIV; valid for PAL_DIV only, not PAL_SEQ (viridis).
## For PAL_SEQ marks nudge labels off the dot; exception is geom_tile heatmaps, which use ink_on_seq() (worst-case 4.16:1).
  on_mark    = "#000000",

  ## Two-tier ink for ink_on_seq(). `on_mark_dark` is #1A1A1A rather
  ## than the #000000 above: on the LIGHT half of viridis both clear the floor
  ## comfortably, and #1A1A1A matches the ink weight of the surrounding axis text,
  ## so the matrix does not look heavier than the panel around it.
  on_mark_dark  = "#1A1A1A",
  on_mark_light = "#FFFFFF"
)

}

)


## Bar chart
thesis_text_col <- function(fill) {
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(fill) / 255
  lum <- 0.299 * rgb[1, ] + 0.587 * rgb[2, ] + 0.114 * rgb[3, ]
  ifelse(lum > 0.5, "black", "white")
}

thesis_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), NA_character_,
  ifelse(p < 1e-3, "***",
  ifelse(p < 1e-2, "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "n.s."))))
}

thesis_p_expr <- function(p, digits = 2) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
  ## The formatted value is QUOTED, so plotmath prints it as formatted rather
  ## than re-formatting it as a number: unquoted, a Fisher p of 1.000 renders
  ## as "1" and 2.10 as "2.1", losing the fixed significant figures that
  ## must be preserved at every mention.
  if (p < 1e-3) {
    parts <- strsplit(formatC(p, format = "e", digits = digits), "e")[[1]]
    sprintf("italic(p)=='%s' %%*%% 10^{%d}", parts[1], as.integer(parts[2]))
  } else {
    ## `digits` governs both branches. "fg" formats to significant digits
    ## rather than decimal places; flag "#" keeps trailing zeros (p = 1
    ## prints 1.0, not 1).
    sprintf("italic(p)=='%s'",
            formatC(signif(p, digits), format = "fg", digits = digits,
                    flag = "#"))
  }
}

thesis_bar <- function(data, x, y, fill = x,
                        value = NULL, value_fmt = "%.1f%%",
                        count = NULL, sig = NULL,
                        facet = NULL, n_lab = NULL, n_lab_size = 3.0,
                        fills = NULL, y_max = NULL, y_lab = NULL,
                        dashed_at = NULL, global_p = NULL, caption_sig = NULL,
                        inside_frac = 0.28, bar_width = 0.62, base_size = 11,
                        title = NULL, facet_free_x = TRUE) {

  d <- as.data.frame(data)
  d$.x <- d[[x]]; d$.y <- d[[y]]; d$.fill <- d[[fill]]

  ## primary value label
  if (!is.null(value)) {
    d$.value <- as.character(d[[value]])
  } else if (!is.na(value_fmt)) {
    d$.value <- sprintf(value_fmt, d$.y)
  } else {
    d$.value <- NA_character_
  }
  d$.count <- if (!is.null(count)) as.character(d[[count]]) else NA_character_
  d$.sig   <- if (!is.null(sig))   as.character(d[[sig]])   else NA_character_

  ## y range + headroom (space for the star that always sits above the bar)
  y_top_data <- max(d$.y, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(y_max)) y_max <- y_top_data * 1.32
  gap  <- 0.045 * y_max            # one label-line height, scaled to axis
  inside_cut <- inside_frac * y_max

  ## fill -> contrast colour for inside text
  if (!is.null(fills)) {
    missing_fill <- setdiff(unique(as.character(d$.fill)), names(fills))
    if (length(missing_fill))
      stop("thesis_bar(): fill level(s) not found in `fills` (would render grey): ",
           paste(sprintf("'%s'", missing_fill), collapse = ", "),
           "\n  Available in `fills`: ",
           paste(sprintf("'%s'", names(fills)), collapse = ", "))
  }
  fill_levels <- if (!is.null(fills)) names(fills) else unique(as.character(d$.fill))
  fill_cols   <- if (!is.null(fills)) fills else scales::hue_pal()(length(fill_levels))
  names(fill_cols) <- fill_levels
  d$.txtcol <- thesis_text_col(fill_cols[as.character(d$.fill)])

  ## ---- per-bar label geometry ------------------------------------------
  d$.inside <- d$.y >= inside_cut
  has_count <- !is.na(d$.count)
  # value line: inside -> just below bar top; above -> primary value uppermost
  d$.val_y   <- ifelse(d$.inside, d$.y - gap,
                       ifelse(has_count, d$.y + 2 * gap, d$.y + gap))
  d$.val_col <- ifelse(d$.inside, d$.txtcol, "black")
  # count line: inside -> below the value; above -> nearer the bar than value
  d$.cnt_y   <- ifelse(d$.inside, d$.y - 2 * gap, d$.y + gap)
  d$.cnt_col <- ifelse(d$.inside, d$.txtcol, "black")
  # significance always above the bar; clears above-bar labels when present
  above_labels <- (!d$.inside) & (has_count | !is.na(d$.value))
  d$.sig_y    <- d$.y + ifelse(above_labels, 3 * gap, gap * 1.4)

  ## ---- build plot -------------------------------------------------------
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .x, y = .y, fill = .fill)) +
    geom_col(width = bar_width, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4,
             show.legend = FALSE)

  if (!is.null(dashed_at))
    p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = dashed_at, linetype = "dashed",
                        colour = PAL_INK[["neutral"]], linewidth = 0.5)

  ## value label
  if (any(!is.na(d$.value)))
    p <- p + geom_text(aes(y = .val_y, label = .value, colour = .val_col),
                       fontface = "bold", size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE,
                       na.rm = TRUE)
  ## count label
  if (any(!is.na(d$.count)))
    p <- p + geom_text(aes(y = .cnt_y, label = .count, colour = .cnt_col),
                       size = 3.0, show.legend = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  ## per-bar significance (above, spaced)
  if (any(!is.na(d$.sig)))
    p <- p + geom_text(aes(y = .sig_y, label = .sig),
                       fontface = "italic", size = 3.4, colour = PAL_INK[["annotation"]],
                       na.rm = TRUE)

  p <- p +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cols) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)))

  ## facets, free_x so each panel shows only its own x categories
  if (!is.null(facet))
    p <- p + facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste0("~", facet)), nrow = 1,
                        scales = if (facet_free_x) "free_x" else "fixed")

  ## per-facet n = ... annotation, top-right
  if (!is.null(n_lab)) {
    key <- if (!is.null(facet)) facet else NULL
    nd  <- if (!is.null(key)) d[!duplicated(d[[key]]), ] else d[1, , drop = FALSE]
    nd$.nlab <- as.character(nd[[n_lab]])
    parse_n  <- any(grepl("==|~", nd$.nlab))
    p <- p + geom_text(data = nd,
                       aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = .nlab),
                       hjust = 1.08, vjust = 1.6, size = n_lab_size, colour = PAL_INK[["annotation"]],
                       fontface = "italic", parse = parse_n,
                       inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }

  ## single centred p-value, drawn once (as a plot tag), not per-facet,
  ## so a faceted figure shows one central p-value instead of one per panel.
  plot_tag <- NULL
  if (!is.null(global_p)) plot_tag <- parse(text = thesis_p_expr(global_p))[[1]]

  cap <- caption_sig
  p <- p +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab, title = title, caption = cap, tag = plot_tag) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      ## BOLD: the panel letter is the one bold element of the house style.
      plot.tag          = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold"),
      plot.tag.position  = c(0.5, 0.86),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = base_size - 2, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = base_size - 2, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing    = unit(1.0, "cm"),
      plot.caption     = element_text(hjust = 0, size = base_size - 2.5,
                                      colour = PAL_INK[["outline"]]),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin      = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
    )
  p
}


## Gene symbols of the Fisher et al. (2023) table
map_fisher_symbols <- function(symbols) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(org.Dm.eg.db))
  u   <- unique(trimws(symbols[!is.na(symbols) & nzchar(symbols)]))
  out <- data.frame(SYMBOL = u, FLYBASE = NA_character_, route = NA_character_,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  sel <- function(k, kt) {
    k <- intersect(k, AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Dm.eg.db, keytype = kt))
    if (!length(k)) return(data.frame(key = character(0), FLYBASE = character(0)))
    d <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::select(org.Dm.eg.db, keys = k,
                                                keytype = kt, columns = "FLYBASE"))
    d <- d[!is.na(d$FLYBASE), , drop = FALSE]
    names(d)[1] <- "key"; d
  }
  # 1. current symbol
  d1 <- sel(u, "SYMBOL"); d1 <- d1[!duplicated(d1$key), ]
  i  <- match(out$SYMBOL, d1$key)
  out$FLYBASE <- d1$FLYBASE[i]; out$route[!is.na(i)] <- "symbol"
  claimed <- unique(out$FLYBASE[!is.na(out$FLYBASE)])
  # 2. unambiguous alias, 3. CG number
  for (rt in c("ALIAS", "FLYBASECG")) {
    rest <- out$SYMBOL[is.na(out$FLYBASE)]
    if (rt == "FLYBASECG") rest <- rest[grepl("^CG[0-9]+$", rest)]
    d <- sel(rest, rt)
    amb <- unique(d$key[duplicated(d$key)])
    d <- d[!d$key %in% amb & !d$FLYBASE %in% claimed, , drop = FALSE]
    d <- d[!duplicated(d$FLYBASE) & !duplicated(d$key), , drop = FALSE]
    j <- match(out$SYMBOL, d$key); hit <- is.na(out$FLYBASE) & !is.na(j)
    out$FLYBASE[hit] <- d$FLYBASE[j[hit]]
    out$route[hit]   <- tolower(rt)
    claimed <- unique(c(claimed, d$FLYBASE))
  }
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(out$FLYBASE[!is.na(out$FLYBASE)]))
  out
}

FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "results", "figures")
CH5_INPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data", "chapter5")

# ---- 2. Constants & helpers (inlined from Chapter 3 so no sourcing needed) ----
good_chr <- c("chr2L", "chr2R", "chr3L", "chr3R", "chr4", "chrX")

# fmt_p: format a p-value in scientific notation, e.g. "4.39e-13"
# (identical to the Chapter 3 definition)
fmt_p <- function(p, digits = 2) {
  formatted <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = digits)
  parts     <- strsplit(formatted, "e")[[1]]
  paste0(parts[1], "e", as.integer(parts[2]))
}

# ---- 3. Packages ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(ChIPseeker)
  library(TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene)
  library(org.Dm.eg.db)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
})
txdb <- TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene

# ---- 4. Rebuild Trh_Tgo_joint_filt from raw IDR narrowPeak files ----
# This is the canonical Chapter 4 recipe (chunk `trh-tgo-joint`):
#   import -> chr-filter + dedup (clean_peak_set) -> pintersect -> dedup -> 614.
# It depends only on the two narrowPeak files on disk, not on any in-memory
# object from another chapter.
extraCols_narrowPeak <- c(signalValue = "numeric", pValue = "numeric",
                          qValue = "numeric", peak = "integer")

trh_narrowPeak_file <- file.path(FINAL_DIR, "TRH_IDR0.05.final.narrowPeak")
tgo_narrowPeak_file <- file.path(FINAL_DIR, "TGO_IDR0.05.final.narrowPeak")
stopifnot(file.exists(trh_narrowPeak_file), file.exists(tgo_narrowPeak_file))

clean_peak_set <- function(gr, label) {
  gr_chr   <- gr[seqnames(gr) %in% good_chr]
  gr_chr   <- keepSeqlevels(gr_chr, good_chr, pruning.mode = "coarse")
  gr_dedup <- gr_chr[!duplicated(gr_chr)]
  cat(sprintf("%s: %d raw -> %d chr-filtered -> %d deduplicated\n",
              label, length(gr), length(gr_chr), length(gr_dedup)))
  gr_dedup
}

Trh_ChIP_peaks <- import(trh_narrowPeak_file, format = "BED",
                         extraCols = extraCols_narrowPeak)
Tgo_ChIP_peaks <- import(tgo_narrowPeak_file, format = "BED",
                         extraCols = extraCols_narrowPeak)

Trh_clean <- clean_peak_set(Trh_ChIP_peaks, "Trh")
Tgo_clean <- clean_peak_set(Tgo_ChIP_peaks, "Tgo")

ovlp_trh_tgo  <- findOverlaps(Trh_clean, Tgo_clean,
                              minoverlap = 1, ignore.strand = TRUE)
Trh_Tgo_joint <- pintersect(Trh_clean[queryHits(ovlp_trh_tgo)],
                            Tgo_clean[subjectHits(ovlp_trh_tgo)])
mcols(Trh_Tgo_joint) <- mcols(Trh_Tgo_joint)[, intersect(
  c("signalValue", "qValue"), colnames(mcols(Trh_Tgo_joint))), drop = FALSE]
Trh_Tgo_joint_filt <- keepSeqlevels(Trh_Tgo_joint, good_chr,
                                    pruning.mode = "coarse")
Trh_Tgo_joint_filt <- Trh_Tgo_joint_filt[!duplicated(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)]

# ---- 5. Verify the canonical invariant ----
stopifnot(inherits(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt, "GRanges"),
          length(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt) == 614L)
cat(sprintf("Bootstrap complete. Trh_Tgo_joint_filt = %d peaks (canonical 614).\n",
            length(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)))
```

```{r ch5-load-inputs, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ---- Load gene lists with column-name tolerance ----
# Finds the gene-ID column whatever it is named.
find_id_col <- function(df, patterns = c("^gene$", "^FBgn", "^flybase",
                                         "gene_id", "fb.*id", "^id$", "FBgnID")) {
  for (pat in patterns) {
    hit <- grep(pat, names(df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit) > 0L) return(hit[[1]])
  }
  stop("No gene-identifier column found in: ",
       paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
}
read_gene_list <- function(path) {
  l1  <- trimws(readLines(path, n = 1))
  hdr <- !grepl("^\"?FBgn[0-9]{7}\"?$", l1)   # first line is a gene => no header
  df  <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = hdr)
  # Headerless files are single-column by construction; read.csv names that
  # column V1, which find_id_col cannot match, so take it positionally.
  ids <- as.character(if (hdr) df[[find_id_col(df)]] else df[[1L]])
  unique(ids[nzchar(ids) & !is.na(ids)])
}

fisher_degs      <- read_gene_list(P_FISHER_DEGS)
rib_target_genes <- read_gene_list(P_RIB_TARGETS)

# marray_st13_genes / marray_st14_genes are not loaded here. They are
# produced by the concordance chunk (ch5-microarray-fisher-concordance) and
# exported to the global environment at the end of that chunk. The concordance
# chunk runs below, before any downstream chunk that uses them.

cat("Fisher RNA-seq DEG list:        ", length(fisher_degs),      "genes\n")
cat("Loganathan Rib direct targets:  ", length(rib_target_genes), "genes\n")
```

```{r ch5-fig-trh-expression-line, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# Fig 5.3: trh knock-down efficacy, stages 11-15, values read from files not hardcoded.
# CG6883-RA is the only trh probe (FBgn0262139); per-replicate aggregation of S*.M columns gives limma log2FC -0.054, +0.132, +0.384, +0.558, +0.081.
# RT-qPCR gives the single-gene measurement; array probe kept as secondary trace with detection floor noted.

stage_ids <- 11:15

read_limma_stage <- function(st)
  read.delim(file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, sprintf("R%d.vsn.limma.fdr.txt.gz", st)),
             skip = 1, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

##, 1. trh on the array (probe CG6883-RA) -----------------------------------
trh_array <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stage_ids, function(st) {
  d <- read_limma_stage(st)
  r <- d[d$TargetID == "CG6883-RA", , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == 1L)
  data.frame(stage = st,
             log2FC = as.numeric(r$logFC),
             SE     = as.numeric(r$logFC) / as.numeric(r$t),
             padj   = as.numeric(r[["adj.P.Val"]]))
}))
stopifnot(all(trh_array$padj > 0.05))   # array never calls trh significant

## 2. trh by RT-qPCR: point estimates only, no independent error
## log2FC/SE/p from prep-level Ct in trh_qpcr_recomputed.xlsx (sheet dCt_per_prep)
## Arms R=trh-RNAi, V=WT; ddCt=dCt(R)-dCt(V), log2FC=-ddCt; 3 preps/arm/stage, paired to rp49
TRH_CT_XLSX <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, "trh_qpcr_recomputed.xlsx")
stopifnot(file.exists(TRH_CT_XLSX))
.dct <- readxl::read_excel(TRH_CT_XLSX, sheet = "dCt_per_prep")
names(.dct) <- c("arm", "arm_meaning", "stage", "prep", "Ct_rp49", "Ct_trh", "dCt")
stopifnot(nrow(.dct) == 30L, all(sort(unique(.dct$arm)) == c("R", "V")))

trh_qpcr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stage_ids, function(st) {
  dR <- .dct$dCt[.dct$arm == "R" & .dct$stage == st]
  dV <- .dct$dCt[.dct$arm == "V" & .dct$stage == st]
  stopifnot(length(dR) == 3L, length(dV) == 3L)
  tt <- t.test(dR, dV, var.equal = FALSE)          # Welch: preps are independent
  se <- sqrt(var(dR) / 3 + var(dV) / 3)
  # Exact two-sided permutation p: enumerate all choose(6,3) = 20 ways of
  # splitting the six preparations into two groups of three, and count how many
  # give a mean difference at least as extreme as the observed one. This makes no
  # distributional assumption, and its FLOOR is 2/20 = 0.05 one-sided-equivalent
  # (0.10 two-sided) whatever the effect size, reported alongside the Welch p
  # so the resolution limit of an n = 3 design is stated rather than implied.
  .all <- c(dR, dV)
  .idx <- utils::combn(6L, 3L)
  .perm <- apply(.idx, 2L, function(i) mean(.all[i]) - mean(.all[-i]))
  p_perm <- mean(abs(.perm) >= abs(mean(dR) - mean(dV)) - 1e-12)
  data.frame(stage = st, log2FC = -(mean(dR) - mean(dV)), SE = se,
             p_welch = tt$p.value, p_perm = p_perm)
}))
# The permutation floor is a property of the design, not the data: with 3 vs 3
# no arrangement can return less than 2/20. This is asserted so that a future change in
# replicate number cannot silently invalidate the reported result.
stopifnot(min(trh_qpcr$p_perm) >= 2 / choose(6, 3) - 1e-12)
stopifnot(nrow(trh_qpcr) == 5L, !any(is.na(trh_qpcr$log2FC)), !any(is.na(trh_qpcr$SE)))
# Check: the CSV trh row must agree with the Ct derivation, or the two sources
# have drifted apart and the concordance panels would disagree with the figure.
.csv_trh <- sapply(stage_ids, function(st) {
  q <- read.csv(file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, sprintf("st%d_validation_unstacked.csv", st)),
                row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  rownames(q) <- sub("^\ufeff", "", rownames(q)); names(q) <- trimws(names(q))
  as.numeric(q[["RT-qPCR"]][match("trh", rownames(q))])
})
stopifnot(max(abs(.csv_trh - trh_qpcr$log2FC)) < 1e-4)

##, 3. gene-level pass counts ----
# Semantics: a GENE passes if any of its probes passes. Probes carrying a
# comma-separated multi-FBgn assignment are expanded to one entry per gene,
# matching the concordance chunk's clean_limma().
genes_passing <- function(st, use_fold = TRUE) {
  d   <- read_limma_stage(st)
  lfc <- as.numeric(d$logFC); pa <- as.numeric(d[["adj.P.Val"]])
  k   <- !is.na(lfc) & !is.na(pa) & pa < 0.55 &
         (if (use_fold) abs(lfc) >= log2(1.4) else TRUE)
  fb  <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(d$FBgn[k]), ",")))
  length(unique(fb[grepl("^FBgn", fb)]))
}
n_pass_fold <- vapply(stage_ids, genes_passing, integer(1))
n_pass_padj <- vapply(stage_ids, genes_passing, integer(1), use_fold = FALSE)

##, 4. what the array could have detected (stage 13, best-powered) ----------
d13   <- read_limma_stage(13)
p13   <- as.numeric(d13$P.Value); q13 <- as.numeric(d13[["adj.P.Val"]])
p_thr <- max(p13[q13 < 0.05], na.rm = TRUE)      # largest raw p still at BH<0.05
t_crit    <- qt(p_thr / 2, df = 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
se_st13   <- trh_array$SE[trh_array$stage == 13]
mde_log2  <- t_crit * se_st13
mde_fold  <- 2^mde_log2

##, 5. depletion vs cross-platform concordance ------------------------------
# rtqpcr_rs is built by the ch5-fig-rtqpcr-corr chunk; recomputed here if absent
# so this chunk is order-independent.
if (!exists("rtqpcr_rs"))
  rtqpcr_rs <- c(0.2441176, 0.4352941, 0.5617647, 0.5588235, 0.6500000)

# EXACT Spearman (AS 89) throughout, at n = 5 the asymptotic approximation is
# anticonservative (it returns p = 0.037 where the exact test returns 0.083).
ct_stage <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(stage_ids, trh_qpcr$log2FC, method = "spearman"))
ct_conc  <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(trh_qpcr$log2FC, rtqpcr_rs, method = "spearman"))

##, 6. Figure ----------------------------------------------------------------
trh_plot <- rbind(
  # SE is available for the RT-qPCR series: three independent preparations
  # per arm per stage in the raw Ct workbook.
  data.frame(stage = trh_qpcr$stage,  log2FC = trh_qpcr$log2FC,
             SE = trh_qpcr$SE, assay = "RT-qPCR"),
  data.frame(stage = trh_array$stage, log2FC = trh_array$log2FC,
             SE = trh_array$SE,       assay = "Microarray"))
trh_plot$assay <- factor(trh_plot$assay, levels = c("RT-qPCR", "Microarray"))

pal_assay <- c("RT-qPCR" = PAL_SUBUNIT[["Trh"]], "Microarray" = PAL_INK[["fit"]])

p_trh <- ggplot(trh_plot, aes(x = stage, y = log2FC,
                              colour = assay, group = assay)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = PAL_INK[["annotation"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2FC - SE, ymax = log2FC + SE),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_line(aes(linewidth = assay, alpha = assay)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = assay, alpha = assay), size = 2.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_assay, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("RT-qPCR" = 18, "Microarray" = 16), name = NULL) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("RT-qPCR" = 0.9, "Microarray" = 0.6),
                         guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("RT-qPCR" = 1, "Microarray" = 0.6), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = stage_ids) +
  labs(x = "Embryonic stage",
       y = expression(italic("trh")~log[2]~"fold change (RNAi/wt)")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        legend.position = c(0.16, 0.16),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig5_3_trh_expression.png"),
       plot = p_trh, width = 6, height = 3.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat(sprintf("trh RT-qPCR: monotonic, rho = %.2f (exact p = %.4f); st15 = %.2f (%.1f-fold down)\n",
            ct_stage$estimate, ct_stage$p.value,
            trh_qpcr$log2FC[5], 1 / 2^trh_qpcr$log2FC[5]))
cat(sprintf("array detection floor at st13: |log2FC| >= %.2f (%.0f-fold)\n",
            mde_log2, mde_fold))
cat(sprintf("depletion vs concordance: rho = %.2f, exact p = %.3f (n.s. at n = 5)\n",
            ct_conc$estimate, ct_conc$p.value))
```

```{r ch5-fig-cluster-dendrogram, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
library(png)
library(magick)
# INPUT LOCATION: this raw dendrogram is a hand-made input, not a pipeline
# output, so it lives with the other Chapter 5 inputs rather than in the
# figures directory.
src <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, "cluster_dendrogram_raw.png")
if (!file.exists(src))
  stop("missing input ", src, " (expected in data/chapter5/)")
## ============================================================
## STEP 1: add a white strip BELOW the tree (native res preserved)
## ============================================================
pad <- 70      # TUNE: height in px of the white strip added at the bottom

img  <- image_read(src)
info <- image_info(img)
img  <- image_extent(img,
                     geometry_area(width = info$width, height = info$height + pad),
                     gravity = "north", color = "white")   # tree pinned to top, white added at BOTTOM
image_write(img, file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, "tmp_padded.png"))

ras <- readPNG(file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, "tmp_padded.png"))
h <- dim(ras)[1]      # native width/height of the PADDED image -> no rescale
w <- dim(ras)[2]

# OUTPUT NAME: this chunk produces the cluster dendrogram figure referenced
# in the text, written at 445x477 px against this input's 445x407, a
# difference of exactly `pad`.
dendro_out <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "figH_13_cluster_dendrogram_high_res.png")
png(dendro_out,
    width = w, height = h, units = "px", type = "cairo-png")
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(c(0,w), c(0,h), type = "n", xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i", axes = FALSE,
     xlab = "", ylab = "")
rasterImage(ras, 0, 0, w, h)
green <- PAL_HETERO[["Trh/Tgo"]]

## ============================================================
## HEIGHT / VERTICAL POSITION OF THE COMB
## y is measured from the BOTTOM. The comb lives in the white
## strip, so y_base is small (inside the `pad` band).
## ============================================================
y_base   <- 55     # TUNE: y of the horizontal bracket line (within the white strip)
tick_len <- 18     # TUNE: height of the vertical end-ticks (comb teeth), pointing UP toward leaves
label_dy <- 15     # TUNE: how far BELOW the line the stage label sits
## ============================================================

## ============================================================
## HORIZONTAL EXTENT OF EACH SEGMENT (manual pixel x; no coupling)
## ============================================================
segs <- list(
  c(0.11 * w, 0.2825 * w, "St12"),   # TUNE
  c(0.2825 * w, 0.4625 * w, "St13"),   # TUNE
  c(0.4625 * w, 0.6425 * w, "St11"),   # TUNE
  c(0.6425 * w, 0.8225 * w, "St14"),   # TUNE
  c(0.8225 * w, 0.997 * w, "St15")    # TUNE
)
## ============================================================

for (s in segs) {
  x0 <- as.numeric(s[1]); x1 <- as.numeric(s[2])
  segments(x0, y_base, x1, y_base,            col = green, lwd = 4)  # horizontal bar
  segments(x0, y_base, x0, y_base + tick_len, col = green, lwd = 4)  # left tooth (up)
  segments(x1, y_base, x1, y_base + tick_len, col = green, lwd = 4)  # right tooth (up)
  text(mean(c(x0, x1)), y_base - label_dy, labels = s[3],
       col = green, font = 2, cex = 2)
}
dev.off()
```

```{r ch5-fig-rtqpcr-corr, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# Fig 5.5: microarray vs

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

CH5_INPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data", "chapter5")
LIMMA_DIR     <- CH5_INPUT_DIR   # holds R{11..15}.vsn.limma.fdr.txt.gz
stage_ids     <- 11:15

# The 16 validation genes, identified by microarray probe (TargetID). This is
# the single source of truth linking the RT-qPCR gene names to the limma probe
# rows; it is stable across stages.
probe_map <- c(
  "BicC"     = "CG4824-RA",  "PGRP-SB1" = "CG9681-RA",  "Cyp6a19" = "CG10243-RA",
  "dhd"      = "CG4193-RA",  "AsnS"     = "CG33486-RA", "Ect3"    = "CG3132-RA",
  "Phk-3"    = "CG9358-RA",  "Cpr51A"   = "CG10112-RA", "trh"     = "CG6883-RA",
  "Cyp12a4"  = "CG6042-RA",  "Cyp309a2" = "CG18559-RA", "ninaD"   = "CG31783-RA",
  "CG14102"  = "CG14102-RA", "Cdc42"    = "CG12530-RB", "Sli"     = "CG8355-RC",
  "Ir7b"     = "CG15326-RA"
)

read_marray_stage <- function(st) {
  f <- file.path(LIMMA_DIR, sprintf("R%d.vsn.limma.fdr.txt.gz", st))
  stopifnot(file.exists(f))
  # First line is an annotation comment; real header is line 2.
  lim <- read.delim(f, skip = 1, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(c("TargetID", "logFC", "t") %in% names(lim)))
  idx <- match(probe_map, lim$TargetID)
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(idx)))            # every probe must resolve
  data.frame(
    gene       = names(probe_map),
    microarray = as.numeric(lim$logFC[idx]),
    marray_se  = as.numeric(lim$logFC[idx]) / as.numeric(lim$t[idx]),
    row.names  = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

read_rtqpcr_stage <- function(st) {
  f <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, sprintf("st%d_validation_unstacked.csv", st))
  stopifnot(file.exists(f))
  d <- read.csv(f, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
  names(d)[names(d) %in% c("RT-qPCR", "RT.qPCR")] <- "RTqPCR"
  data.frame(gene = rownames(d), RTqPCR = as.numeric(d$RTqPCR),
             row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

build_panel <- function(st, panel_tag) {
  d <- merge(read_marray_stage(st), read_rtqpcr_stage(st), by = "gene")
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == 16L)              # all 16 genes, no silent loss
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$microarray, d$RTqPCR, method = "spearman"))
  rs <- unname(ct$estimate); pv <- ct$p.value

  # Significant stages (p < 0.05) get a blue fitted line; non-significant
  # stages keep a neutral grey line. Blue is the conventional "fitted model"
  # colour and is reserved here for significance; red is not used (in this
  # thesis red denotes the trh data trace in Fig 5.3, not a regression fit).
  sig       <- pv < 0.05
  line_col  <- if (sig) PAL_INK[["fit"]] else PAL_INK[["neutral"]]

  # Annotation placement: stages 11 and 12 have a data point in the top-left
  # corner, so their R_s / p labels go to the BOTTOM-left; all other stages
  # keep the labels top-left where the corner is clear.
  if (st %in% c(11L, 12L)) {
    lab_x <- Inf;  lab_y <- -Inf
    h_rs  <- 1.12; v_rs  <- -3.4
    h_p   <- 1.12; v_p   <- -1.7   # bottom-right, stacked upward
  } else {
    lab_x <- -Inf; lab_y <-  Inf
    h_rs  <- -0.12; v_rs <-  1.5
    h_p   <- -0.12; v_p  <-  3.2   # top-left, stacked downward
  }

  list(
    stage = st, n = nrow(d), Rs = rs, p = pv, data = d, sig = sig,
    plot  = ggplot(d, aes(x = RTqPCR, y = microarray)) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      stat_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
                  se = FALSE, colour = line_col, linewidth = 0.6) +
      ggtitle(paste("Stage", st)) +
      labs(tag = panel_tag,
           x   = expression("RT-qPCR " * log[2] * " FC"),
           y   = expression("microarray " * log[2] * " FC")) +
      annotate("text", x = lab_x, y = lab_y, hjust = h_rs, vjust = v_rs,
               parse = TRUE, size = 3.5,
               label = sprintf("italic(R)[s] == %.2f", rs)) +
      annotate("text", x = lab_x, y = lab_y, hjust = h_p, vjust = v_p,
               parse = TRUE, size = 3.5,
               label = sprintf("italic(p) == %.3f", pv)) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            plot.tag   = element_text(size = 14))
  )
}

panels <- Map(build_panel, stage_ids, LETTERS[seq_along(stage_ids)])

rtqpcr_stats <- data.frame(
  stage = paste("Stage", stage_ids),
  Rs    = vapply(panels, `[[`, numeric(1), "Rs"),
  p     = vapply(panels, `[[`, numeric(1), "p")
)
print(rtqpcr_stats)

# 3 rows x 2 cols (panels A-E + one empty slot) -> single fig5_4.png
fig5_5 <- (panels[[1]]$plot | panels[[2]]$plot) /
          (panels[[3]]$plot | panels[[4]]$plot) /
          (panels[[5]]$plot | plot_spacer())
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig5_4.png"),
       plot = fig5_5, width = 8, height = 11, dpi = 300)
print(fig5_5)
```

```{r ch5-microarray-fisher-concordance, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ---- Section 5.4: rank concordance analysis, not Venn ----
# Inputs: Limma per-stage outputs (st13, st14), Fisher 2022 modERN
# trh-RNAi DESeq2 table. Outputs: fig5_5_concordance.png,
# merged_microarray_fisher_st{13,14}.csv, microarray_validated_st{13,14}.csv,
# values in results/reported_values.tsv. Re-running overwrites all outputs.
 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr); library(readxl); library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(hexbin)
})
 
# ---- Paths ----
P_LIMMA_ST13 <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, "R13.vsn.limma.fdr.txt.gz")
P_LIMMA_ST14 <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, "R14.vsn.limma.fdr.txt.gz")
P_FISHER_XLS <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR,
                          "modERN_Resource_RNAi_Table_S43_trh_GENETICS-2022-305822.xlsx")
for (P in c(P_LIMMA_ST13, P_LIMMA_ST14, P_FISHER_XLS)) {
  if (!file.exists(P))
    stop("Missing input for concordance analysis: ", P)
}
 
# ---- 1. Parse Limma microarray output (skip '#' comment header) ----
read_limma <- function(path) {
  raw <- readLines(path); raw <- raw[!grepl("^#", raw)]
  read.delim(text = paste(raw, collapse = "\n"),
             header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
}
 
clean_limma <- function(d) {
  # probes with multi-FBgn assignment are expanded to one row per FBgn
  d$logFC <- as.numeric(d$logFC); d$P.Value <- as.numeric(d$P.Value)
  d$adj.P.Val <- as.numeric(d$adj.P.Val)
  d <- d[grepl("FBgn\\d+", d$FBgn), , drop = FALSE]
 
  fb_list  <- strsplit(d$FBgn, ",")
  sym_list <- strsplit(sub(",$", "", d$GeneName), ",")
  lens     <- vapply(fb_list, length, integer(1))
  d_exp    <- d[rep(seq_len(nrow(d)), lens), , drop = FALSE]
  d_exp$FBgn <- unlist(fb_list)
  d_exp$symbol <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(fb_list), function(i) {
    s <- sym_list[[i]]; n <- lens[i]
    if (length(s) == n) s else rep(s[1], n)
  }))
 
  # gene-level aggregation: keep most-significant probe per FBgn
  d_exp <- d_exp[order(d_exp$adj.P.Val), , drop = FALSE]
  d_exp <- d_exp[!duplicated(d_exp$FBgn), , drop = FALSE]
  d_exp[, c("FBgn", "symbol", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")]
}
 
l13 <- clean_limma(read_limma(P_LIMMA_ST13))
l14 <- clean_limma(read_limma(P_LIMMA_ST14))
 
# ---- 2. Parse Fisher DESeq2 sheet and resolve symbols -> FBgn ----
fis <- read_excel(P_FISHER_XLS, sheet = "DESeq2 CSV") |>
  dplyr::rename(symbol = `gene name`,
         log2FC_fisher_0_1.5  = `log2FoldChange.trh_0.1.5`,
         padj_fisher_0_1.5    = `padj.trh_0.1.5`,
         log2FC_fisher_6_8    = `log2FC_6.8`,
         padj_fisher_6_8      = `padj_6.8`,
         log2FC_fisher_16_18  = `log2FC_16.18`,
         padj_fisher_16_18    = `padj_16.18`) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(symbol))
 
sym2fbgn <- setNames(l13$FBgn, l13$symbol)
fis$FBgn <- sym2fbgn[fis$symbol]
n_fisher_total  <- nrow(fis)
n_fisher_mapped <- sum(!is.na(fis$FBgn))
 
fis <- fis |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(FBgn)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(FBgn) |> dplyr::arrange(padj_fisher_6_8) |> dplyr::slice(1) |> ungroup()
 
# ---- 3. Merge per-stage ----
merge_stage <- function(limma_d, fis_d, stage_lbl) {
  limma_d |>
    dplyr::rename(logFC_microarray = logFC,
           P_microarray     = P.Value,
           padj_microarray  = adj.P.Val) |>
    inner_join(fis_d |> dplyr::select(FBgn,
                               log2FC_fisher_0_1.5, padj_fisher_0_1.5,
                               log2FC_fisher_6_8,   padj_fisher_6_8,
                               log2FC_fisher_16_18, padj_fisher_16_18),
               by = "FBgn") |>
    dplyr::mutate(stage = stage_lbl)
}
m13 <- merge_stage(l13, fis, "st13")
m14 <- merge_stage(l14, fis, "st14")
 
write_csv(m13, file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "merged_microarray_fisher_st13.csv"))
write_csv(m14, file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "merged_microarray_fisher_st14.csv"))
 
# ---- 4. Concordance statistics ----
windows <- c(early = "log2FC_fisher_0_1.5",
             mid   = "log2FC_fisher_6_8",
             late  = "log2FC_fisher_16_18")
 
concord_one <- function(d, ywin) {
  s <- d[, c("logFC_microarray", ywin)] |> drop_na()
  sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(s$logFC_microarray, s[[ywin]],
                                  method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  data.frame(n = nrow(s),
             rho = unname(sp$estimate),
             p = sp$p.value,
             sign_concord = mean(sign(s$logFC_microarray) == sign(s[[ywin]])))
}
 
stat13 <- lapply(windows, concord_one, d = m13) |> setNames(names(windows))
stat14 <- lapply(windows, concord_one, d = m14) |> setNames(names(windows))
 
# ---- 5. Validated subsets: microarray |logFC|>=0.49, padj<0.55, ----
# ---- Fisher 6-8h |log2FC|>=0.49, padj<0.05 ----
mar_st13_set <- m13 |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(logFC_microarray) >= 0.49, padj_microarray < 0.55) |>
  pull(FBgn)
mar_st14_set <- m14 |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(logFC_microarray) >= 0.49, padj_microarray < 0.55) |>
  pull(FBgn)
fisher_set <- m13 |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FC_fisher_6_8) >= 0.49, padj_fisher_6_8 < 0.05) |>
  pull(FBgn)
 
valid_st13 <- intersect(mar_st13_set, fisher_set)
valid_st14 <- intersect(mar_st14_set, fisher_set)
 
writeLines(c("FBgnID", valid_st13),
           file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "microarray_validated_st13.csv"))
writeLines(c("FBgnID", valid_st14),
           file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "microarray_validated_st14.csv"))
 
sub13 <- m13 |> dplyr::filter(FBgn %in% valid_st13)
sub14 <- m14 |> dplyr::filter(FBgn %in% valid_st14)
sign_c_valid_st13 <- mean(sign(sub13$logFC_microarray) ==
                          sign(sub13$log2FC_fisher_6_8))
sign_c_valid_st14 <- mean(sign(sub14$logFC_microarray) ==
                          sign(sub14$log2FC_fisher_6_8))
 
cat(sprintf("Validated subset: st13=%d, st14=%d, union=%d, intersection=%d\n",
            length(valid_st13), length(valid_st14),
            length(union(valid_st13, valid_st14)),
            length(intersect(valid_st13, valid_st14))))
cat(sprintf("Genome-wide rho st13 vs Fisher 6–8h: %.3f  (n=%d)\n",
            stat13$mid$rho, stat13$mid$n))
cat(sprintf("Genome-wide rho st14 vs Fisher 6–8h: %.3f  (n=%d)\n",
            stat14$mid$rho, stat14$mid$n))
 
# ---- 6. Figure: 6-panel concordance scatter ----
# Per-window x-scaling; shared log10 density colourbar; concordant-quadrant
# tint; "OLS trend" and "Validated subset" legend keys; role-named headers.
# ASCII hyphens in plotted text. Requires hexbin (loaded in ch5-setup chunk).

# Per-window symmetric x-limits: cover ~99.5% of |FC| and enclose every
# validated (red) point, so no highlighted DEG is clipped off-panel (the
# validated genes have larger FC than the bulk by construction). Round up to 0.1.
xlim_for <- function(col) {
  allv <- c(m13[[col]], m14[[col]])
  red  <- c(m13[[col]][m13$FBgn %in% valid_st13],
            m14[[col]][m14$FBgn %in% valid_st14])
  need <- max(quantile(abs(allv), 0.995, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(abs(red), na.rm = TRUE))
  l <- ceiling(need * 10) / 10
  c(-l, l)
}
.wins  <- c("log2FC_fisher_0_1.5", "log2FC_fisher_6_8", "log2FC_fisher_16_18")
.xlims <- sapply(.wins, xlim_for)

# Shared fill limits: global max hexbin count across all six panels. Must mirror
# the panel binning exactly (visible window only, xbins = 34) or the colourbar
# ceiling will not match the darkest hexagon actually drawn.
.gmax <- 0
.yl <- c(-1.5, 1.5)
for (i in seq_along(.wins)) {
  ww <- .wins[i]; lim <- .xlims[, i]
  for (mm in list(m13, m14)) {
    dd <- mm[, c(ww, "logFC_microarray")]; dd <- dd[stats::complete.cases(dd), ]
    dd <- dd[dd[[ww]] >= lim[1] & dd[[ww]] <= lim[2] &
             dd$logFC_microarray >= .yl[1] & dd$logFC_microarray <= .yl[2], ]
    hbc <- hexbin::hexbin(dd[[ww]], dd$logFC_microarray, xbins = 34)@count
    .gmax <- max(.gmax, hbc)
  }
}

make_panel <- function(m, ywin, xlim, highlight_fbgn, xlab, show_y, show_x,
                       label_pos = "topleft") {
  d <- m |> dplyr::select(FBgn, logFC_microarray, all_of(ywin)) |> drop_na()
  names(d)[3] <- "fisher_fc"
  d$highlight <- d$FBgn %in% highlight_fbgn
  rho <- suppressWarnings(cor(d$logFC_microarray, d$fisher_fc,
                              method = "spearman"))
  sign_c <- mean(sign(d$logFC_microarray) == sign(d$fisher_fc))
  # blank line before "n =" opens vertical space; hjust = 0 (below) keeps all
  # three lines flush-left at the same edge.
  lbl <- sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f\nsign concord. = %.0f%%\n\nn = %s",
                 rho, 100 * sign_c, format(nrow(d), big.mark = ""))
  yl <- c(-1.5, 1.5)
  # Bin only the data inside the display window, so hexagon size is tied to the
  # visible range and is not magnified by coord_cartesian zoom (binning the full
  # +-3 range then zooming to +-1 stretches the hexagons). Stats, trend line and
  # highlighted points still use the full data (d).
  dv <- d |> dplyr::filter(fisher_fc >= xlim[1], fisher_fc <= xlim[2],
                    logFC_microarray >= yl[1], logFC_microarray <= yl[2])
  # Text inset in data coordinates, kept off the spines. "topleft" (stage 13):
  # anchored 5% in from the left, 4% down from the top, left-aligned. "bottomright"
  # (stage 14, where the empty quadrant is bottom-right): anchored 5% in from the
  # right, 4% up from the bottom, right-aligned so the block grows leftward into
  # the whitespace without overflowing the panel.
  if (label_pos == "bottomright") {
    tx <- xlim[2] - diff(xlim) * 0.05; thj <- 1
    ty <- yl[1]   + diff(yl)   * 0.04; tvj <- 0
  } else {
    tx <- xlim[1] + diff(xlim) * 0.05; thj <- 0
    ty <- yl[2]   - diff(yl)   * 0.04; tvj <- 1
  }
  ggplot(d, aes(fisher_fc, logFC_microarray)) +
    # tint the two concordant (agreement) quadrants: both up / both down
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = xlim[2], ymin = 0, ymax = yl[2],
             fill = PAL_INK[["highlight_band"]], alpha = 0.05) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = xlim[1], xmax = 0, ymin = yl[1], ymax = 0,
             fill = PAL_INK[["highlight_band"]], alpha = 0.05) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = PAL_INK[["neutral"]]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = PAL_INK[["neutral"]]) +
    geom_hex(data = dv, aes(fill = after_stat(count)), bins = 34) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = PAL_SEQ(9)[9], high = PAL_SEQ(9)[1], trans = "log10",
                        name = "Genes per\nhexbin", limits = c(1, .gmax),
                        breaks = c(1, 10, 100), oob = scales::squish) +
    geom_smooth(aes(colour = "OLS trend"), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
                linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("OLS trend" = PAL_INK[["fit"]]), name = NULL) +
    geom_point(data = subset(d, highlight),
               aes(shape = "Validated subset"),
               colour = PAL_INK[["emphasis"]], size = 1.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Validated subset" = 16), name = NULL) +
    annotate("text", x = tx, y = ty, hjust = thj, vjust = tvj,
             label = lbl, size = 2.5, lineheight = 0.95) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = yl) +
    labs(x = if (show_x) xlab else NULL,
         y = if (show_y) "Microarray log2 FC" else NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text.y = if (show_y) element_text() else element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(2, 4, 2, 2))
}

# Column headers name the biological role; row headers name the stage.
.xlabs <- c("Fisher 0-1.5 h log2 FC", "Fisher 6-8 h log2 FC",
            "Fisher 16-18 h log2 FC")
.csub  <- c("Fisher 0-1.5 h", "Fisher 6-8 h", "Fisher 16-18 h")
.ctitle<- c("Negative control", "Temporal proxy (closest)",
            "Developmental endpoint")
mk_hdr <- function(t, s)
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.62, label = t, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.15, label = s, size = 2.7, colour = PAL_INK[["annotation"]]) +
    theme_void() + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
mk_row <- function(t)
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = t, fontface = "bold",
                      size = 3, angle = 90) + theme_void()
.hdrs  <- Map(mk_hdr, .ctitle, .csub)

legend_theme <- theme(legend.position = "right",
                      legend.key.size = unit(0.36, "cm"),
                      legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
                      legend.text  = element_text(size = 7))
guide_spec <- guides(
  fill   = guide_colourbar(order = 1, barheight = unit(1.6, "cm")),
  colour = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(linetype = "dashed")),
  shape  = guide_legend(order = 3))

.P <- list()
for (i in 1:3) {
  .P[[paste0("t13_", i)]] <-
    make_panel(m13, .wins[i], .xlims[, i], valid_st13, .xlabs[i],
               show_y = (i == 1), show_x = FALSE) + legend_theme + guide_spec
  .P[[paste0("t14_", i)]] <-
    make_panel(m14, .wins[i], .xlims[, i], valid_st14, .xlabs[i],
               show_y = (i == 1), show_x = TRUE,
               label_pos = "bottomright") + legend_theme + guide_spec
}

.design <- "
.AAABBBCCC
DEEEFFFGGG
HIIIJJJKKK
"
p_grid <-
  plot_spacer() + .hdrs[[1]] + .hdrs[[2]] + .hdrs[[3]] +
  mk_row("Stage 13") + .P[["t13_1"]] + .P[["t13_2"]] + .P[["t13_3"]] +
  mk_row("Stage 14") + .P[["t14_1"]] + .P[["t14_2"]] + .P[["t14_3"]] +
  plot_layout(design = .design,
              widths  = c(0.10, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
              heights = c(0.14, 1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig5_5_concordance.png"),
       plot = p_grid, width = 11, height = 7.2, units = "in", dpi = 300)
 

# ---- 8. Expose objects to the rest of Chapter 5 ----
# Maintains compatibility with downstream chunks that expect these names:
marray_st13_genes      <- valid_st13
marray_st14_genes      <- valid_st14
marray_validated_total <- length(union(valid_st13, valid_st14))
marray_in_fisher_st13  <- length(valid_st13)
marray_in_fisher_st14  <- length(valid_st14)
# not "by construction": the validated set is filtered on the Fisher 6-8 h
# window (|log2FC_fisher_6_8| >= 0.49 & padj_fisher_6_8 < 0.05), whereas the
# direct-target derivation downstream uses the COMBINED Fisher DEG list.
# FBgn0029128 (tyn) clears the former and not the latter, so the two sets
# differ by one gene. Compute it; never assume the identity.
marray_validated_genes <- union(valid_st13, valid_st14)
marray_in_fisher_total <- sum(marray_validated_genes %in% fisher_degs)
stopifnot(marray_in_fisher_total <= marray_validated_total)
marray_source          <- "live"
```

```{r ch5-chip-annotate-genes, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ---- Annotate Trh/Tgo peaks to nearest gene ----
# Uses ChIPseeker with TSS region of +/- 2kb (matches Chapter 3 convention).
# A peak's "gene assignment" is the FlyBase ID of its nearest TSS within
# the window; peaks whose nearest TSS is beyond the window are dropped.

tss_window <- c(-2000L, 2000L)

peakAnno_trh <- annotatePeak(
  Trh_Tgo_joint_filt,
  TxDb       = txdb,
  tssRegion  = tss_window,
  level      = "gene",
  annoDb     = "org.Dm.eg.db",
  verbose    = FALSE
)

peakAnno_df <- as.data.frame(peakAnno_trh)

# Keep only peaks whose nearest TSS is within +/-2kb
peak_genes_in_window <- subset(peakAnno_df, abs(distanceToTSS) <= 2000L)

# FlyBase ID column from ChIPseeker is typically "geneId" (Ensembl) and
# "ENSEMBL" or "FLYBASE" in annoDb-augmented data. Locate flexibly.
fb_col <- {
  if      ("FLYBASE" %in% names(peak_genes_in_window)) "FLYBASE"
  else if ("flybase" %in% names(peak_genes_in_window)) "flybase"
  else if ("ENSEMBL" %in% names(peak_genes_in_window)) "ENSEMBL"
  else if ("geneId"  %in% names(peak_genes_in_window)) "geneId"
  else stop("No FlyBase/Ensembl gene-ID column in annotated peaks. ",
            "Available columns: ",
            paste(names(peak_genes_in_window), collapse = ", "))
}

trh_chip_genes <- unique(peak_genes_in_window[[fb_col]])
trh_chip_genes <- trh_chip_genes[!is.na(trh_chip_genes) &
                                 nzchar(trh_chip_genes)]

cat("Total Trh/Tgo peaks:                ", length(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt), "\n")
cat("Peaks within +/-2kb of a TSS:       ", nrow(peak_genes_in_window), "\n")
cat("Unique genes near Trh/Tgo peaks:    ", length(trh_chip_genes), "\n")
```

```{r ch5-direct-targets, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ---- Section 5.5: Define direct-target set ----
# Direct target = gene whose TSS is within +/-2kb of a Trh/Tgo peak and
# is differentially expressed in the Fisher trh-RNAi RNA-seq dataset.

direct_targets_trh <- intersect(trh_chip_genes, fisher_degs)

cat("Direct Trh/Tgo targets (ChIP n DEG):", length(direct_targets_trh), "\n")

# Hypergeometric test: are direct targets enriched relative to background?
# Null: among all dm6 genes, the proportion that are DEGs is the same
# whether or not they have a nearby Trh/Tgo peak.
all_dm6_genes <- keys(org.Dm.eg.db, keytype = "FLYBASE")

q_overlap   <- length(intersect(trh_chip_genes, fisher_degs))
m_in_chip   <- length(intersect(trh_chip_genes, all_dm6_genes))
n_not_chip  <- length(all_dm6_genes) - m_in_chip
k_in_fisher <- length(intersect(fisher_degs, all_dm6_genes))

# Probability of observing >= q_overlap by chance:
p_hyper_trh <- phyper(q_overlap - 1L, k_in_fisher,
                      length(all_dm6_genes) - k_in_fisher,
                      m_in_chip, lower.tail = FALSE)
fold_enrich_trh <- (q_overlap / m_in_chip) /
                   (k_in_fisher / length(all_dm6_genes))

cat(sprintf("Hypergeometric p (direct target enrichment): %.3g\n",
            p_hyper_trh))
cat(sprintf("Fold enrichment over background:             %.2f\n",
            fold_enrich_trh))

# Restrict draw and DEG set to the 11120-gene merged microarray/RNA-seq
# table (the testable universe). trh_chip_genes comes from all annotated
# dm6 genes, so part of it falls outside this universe.
univ_genes  <- unique(m13$FBgn[!is.na(m13$FBgn)])
chip_in_u   <- intersect(trh_chip_genes, univ_genes)
degs_in_u   <- intersect(fisher_degs,    univ_genes)
ov_in_u     <- intersect(chip_in_u,      degs_in_u)

u_N <- length(univ_genes); u_n <- length(chip_in_u)
u_K <- length(degs_in_u);  u_k <- length(ov_in_u)
stopifnot(u_n <= u_N, u_K <= u_N, u_k <= min(u_n, u_K))

u_exp  <- u_n * u_K / u_N
u_fold <- u_k / u_exp
u_pdep <- phyper(u_k, u_K, u_N - u_K, u_n, lower.tail = TRUE)
u_ft   <- fisher.test(matrix(c(u_k, u_n - u_k,
                               u_K - u_k, u_N - u_K - u_n + u_k), 2, 2))
# one-sided power to detect a true two-fold enrichment at this draw size
u_crit <- qhyper(0.95, u_K, u_N - u_K, u_n)
u_pow2 <- sum(dhyper(seq(u_crit + 1L, u_n), round(2 * u_K),
                     u_N - round(2 * u_K), u_n))

cat(sprintf(paste0("Universe-restricted: N=%d K=%d n=%d (of %d; %d outside) ",
                   "k=%d exp=%.1f fold=%.2f p_dep=%.3f OR=%.2f [%.2f,%.2f] ",
                   "power(2x)=%.3f\n"),
            u_N, u_K, u_n, length(trh_chip_genes),
            length(trh_chip_genes) - u_n, u_k, u_exp, u_fold, u_pdep,
            u_ft$estimate, u_ft$conf.int[1], u_ft$conf.int[2], u_pow2))

# Save the direct-target list
write.csv(
  data.frame(FBgn = direct_targets_trh),
  file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "direct_targets_TrhTgo.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r ch5-direct-targets-table, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# Per-gene direct-target table for Section 5.5.
# Joins 21-gene direct-target list (FBgn, from ch5-direct-targets chunk),
# peak annotation table (signal, width, dist to TSS), and Fisher 2023
# RNA-seq per-gene fold-change table (SYMBOL).
# Fisher symbols mapped to FBgn via org.Dm.eg.db at join; unmappable
# symbols printed. Output: direct_targets_with_intensity_and_fc.csv.

# Pre-flight
required <- c("direct_targets_trh", "peakAnno_df", "Trh_Tgo_joint",
              "fb_col")
missing  <- setdiff(required, ls(envir = .GlobalEnv))
if (length(missing) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing prerequisites: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(org.Dm.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
})

# ---- Step 1: Get peak intensity for each direct target ----
annotated <- peakAnno_df[peakAnno_df[[fb_col]] %in% direct_targets_trh, ]
stopifnot(nrow(annotated) > 0L)

annotated_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = annotated$seqnames,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = annotated$start, end = annotated$end),
  strand   = "*"
)

ov <- findOverlaps(annotated_gr, Trh_Tgo_joint, type = "equal")
annotated$signalValue <- NA_real_
annotated$signalValue[queryHits(ov)] <-
  Trh_Tgo_joint$signalValue[subjectHits(ov)]

# Pick highest-signal peak per gene
per_gene_peaks <- by(annotated,
                     INDICES = annotated[[fb_col]],
                     FUN = function(df) {
                       df[which.max(df$signalValue), , drop = FALSE]
                     })
per_gene_peaks <- do.call(rbind, per_gene_peaks)
per_gene_peaks <- per_gene_peaks[, c(fb_col, "SYMBOL", "width",
                                     "signalValue", "distanceToTSS")]
names(per_gene_peaks)[1] <- "gene_id"

# ---- Step 2: Load Fisher 2023 per-gene table ----
# the file is tab-separated and uses decimal commas
# (European locale). Both must be specified to read.delim or numeric
# columns will be parsed as strings.

P_FISHER_PERGENE <- file.path(
  REFERENCE_LISTS,
  "Fisher2023_per_gene_fold_changes.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(P_FISHER_PERGENE)) {
  stop("Fisher per-gene table not found at: ", P_FISHER_PERGENE,
       "\nDownload from the journal supplementary materials and save ",
       "as a TSV (tab-separated, decimal commas) at this path.")
}

# Read as TSV with decimal comma. The columns log2FC_6.8 and padj_6.8
# refer to Fisher 2023's stage-window 6-8; log2FC_16.18 and padj_16.18
# refer to stage-window 16-18.
fisher_raw <- read.delim(
  P_FISHER_PERGENE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  dec = ",",
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  strip.white = TRUE
)

# Trim whitespace from column names (in case of leading spaces)
names(fisher_raw) <- trimws(names(fisher_raw))

# Sanity check expected columns
expected_cols <- c("gene_id", "log2FC_6.8", "padj_6.8",
                   "log2FC_16.18", "padj_16.18")
missing_cols <- setdiff(expected_cols, names(fisher_raw))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0L) {
  stop("Fisher CSV missing expected columns: ",
       paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "\nAvailable: ", paste(names(fisher_raw), collapse = ", "))
}

# Confirm numeric columns parsed correctly
stopifnot(is.numeric(fisher_raw$log2FC_6.8))
cat("Fisher table loaded: ", nrow(fisher_raw), " genes, ",
    "decimal-comma-parsed values numeric.\n", sep = "")

# Rename the symbol column to be explicit
names(fisher_raw)[names(fisher_raw) == "gene_id"] <- "symbol_fisher"
fisher_raw$symbol_fisher <- trimws(fisher_raw$symbol_fisher)

# ---- Step 3: Map Fisher symbols to FBgn ----
# org.Dm.eg.db SYMBOL -> FLYBASE mapping. Many-to-one is possible but
# rare; one-to-many is also possible (one symbol maps to multiple FBgns
# because of historical synonyms). We take the first match per symbol
# and report ambiguities for manual review.

sym2fb <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Dm.eg.db,
  keys     = unique(fisher_raw$symbol_fisher),
  columns  = c("SYMBOL", "FLYBASE"),
  keytype  = "SYMBOL"
)

# Diagnostic: how many symbols are unmappable?
unmappable <- unique(sym2fb$SYMBOL[is.na(sym2fb$FLYBASE)])
n_unmappable <- length(unmappable)
cat("Symbols unmappable to FBgn: ", n_unmappable, " (",
    sprintf("%.1f%%",
            100 * n_unmappable / length(unique(fisher_raw$symbol_fisher))),
    ")\n", sep = "")
if (n_unmappable > 0L && n_unmappable <= 20L) {
  cat("Unmappable symbols (first 20):\n")
  cat(paste("  ", head(unmappable, 20), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}

# Diagnostic: how many symbols map to multiple FBgns?
multi <- sym2fb[!is.na(sym2fb$FLYBASE), ]
multi_counts <- table(multi$SYMBOL)
multi_symbols <- names(multi_counts[multi_counts > 1L])
cat("Symbols mapping to >1 FBgn: ", length(multi_symbols), "\n", sep = "")
if (length(multi_symbols) > 0L && length(multi_symbols) <= 20L) {
  cat("Multi-mapping (taking first):\n")
  for (s in head(multi_symbols, 20)) {
    cat("  ", s, " -> ",
        paste(multi$FLYBASE[multi$SYMBOL == s], collapse = ", "),
        "\n", sep = "")
  }
}

# Take first FBgn per symbol (deterministic; arbitrary among ties)
sym2fb_first <- sym2fb[!duplicated(sym2fb$SYMBOL), ]
sym2fb_first <- sym2fb_first[!is.na(sym2fb_first$FLYBASE), ]

# ---- Fisher (2023) symbols -> FlyBase gene identifiers ----
# Fisher et al. use some historical gene symbols that differ from the current
# org.Dm.eg.db SYMBOL for the same gene; without a synonym route the
# symbol->FBgn join silently drops those rows, leaving blank fold-change cells
# in the per-gene direct-target table. Symbols are mapped by current symbol,
# then unambiguous FlyBase synonym, then CG number (map_fisher_symbols()).
fmap <- map_fisher_symbols(fisher_raw$symbol_fisher)
sym2fb_first <- data.frame(SYMBOL  = fmap$SYMBOL[!is.na(fmap$FLYBASE)],
                           FLYBASE = fmap$FLYBASE[!is.na(fmap$FLYBASE)],
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(sym2fb_first$FLYBASE[sym2fb_first$SYMBOL == "RpII18"] == "FBgn0003275",
          sym2fb_first$FLYBASE[sym2fb_first$SYMBOL == "CG6752"] == "FBgn0038296",
          sym2fb_first$FLYBASE[sym2fb_first$SYMBOL == "RpII15"] == "FBgn0004855")

# Attach FBgn to Fisher table
fisher_raw$gene_id <- sym2fb_first$FLYBASE[
  match(fisher_raw$symbol_fisher, sym2fb_first$SYMBOL)
]

# Drop rows with no FBgn match (can't be joined)
n_before <- nrow(fisher_raw)
fisher_mapped <- fisher_raw[!is.na(fisher_raw$gene_id), ]
n_dropped <- n_before - nrow(fisher_mapped)
cat("Fisher rows after FBgn mapping: ", nrow(fisher_mapped),
    " (", n_dropped, " dropped, no FBgn)\n", sep = "")

# Handle duplicate FBgn -> symbol (rare): keep the row with the
# strongest signal (lowest p across both stages)
if (any(duplicated(fisher_mapped$gene_id))) {
  fisher_mapped$min_padj <- pmin(fisher_mapped$padj_6.8,
                                  fisher_mapped$padj_16.18,
                                  na.rm = TRUE)
  fisher_mapped <- fisher_mapped[order(fisher_mapped$gene_id,
                                        fisher_mapped$min_padj), ]
  fisher_mapped <- fisher_mapped[!duplicated(fisher_mapped$gene_id), ]
  fisher_mapped$min_padj <- NULL
}

# ---- Step 4: Join ----
joined <- merge(
  per_gene_peaks,
  fisher_mapped[, c("gene_id", "symbol_fisher",
                    "log2FC_6.8", "padj_6.8",
                    "log2FC_16.18", "padj_16.18")],
  by    = "gene_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort  = FALSE
)

# Diagnostic: how many of the 21 direct targets have Fisher data?
n_with_fisher <- sum(!is.na(joined$log2FC_6.8) |
                     !is.na(joined$log2FC_16.18))
cat("\nDirect targets with Fisher fold-change data: ",
    n_with_fisher, " / ", nrow(joined), "\n", sep = "")

if (n_with_fisher < nrow(joined)) {
  cat("Direct targets WITHOUT Fisher data (FBgn -> symbol mismatch ",
      "or gene absent from Fisher 2023):\n", sep = "")
  no_fisher <- joined[is.na(joined$log2FC_6.8) &
                      is.na(joined$log2FC_16.18), ]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(no_fisher))) {
    cat("  ", no_fisher$gene_id[i], " (",
        no_fisher$SYMBOL[i], ")\n", sep = "")
  }
}

# ---- Step 5: Sort by signal value and write ----
joined <- joined[order(-joined$signalValue), ]

write.csv(joined,
          file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "direct_targets_with_intensity_and_fc.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nWrote: direct_targets_with_intensity_and_fc.csv (",
    nrow(joined), " rows)\n", sep = "")

# ---- Step 6: Print the table ----
print(joined, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nNote: SYMBOL column is from org.Dm.eg.db (peak annotation).\n")
cat("Fisher's own symbol_fisher column may differ; both are in the CSV.\n")
```
```{r ch5-direct-targets-mapping-sensitivity, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# Sensitivity of the direct-target set to how the Fisher et al. (2023) table is
# joined. The DEG list behind the 21-gene set (Fisher_combined_DEGs.csv) was
# built with |log2FC| >= 0.49 and matched Fisher symbols to current FlyBase
# symbols. The same rule is re-applied here with FlyBase-synonym mapping
# (map_fisher_symbols()), at the stated cut (0.49) and at exactly
# log2(1.4) = 0.485 (the unrounded 1.4-fold cut). The 21-gene set is the
# reported set; these values are reported as a sensitivity analysis.
fs <- read.delim(file.path(REFERENCE_LISTS, "Fisher2023_per_gene_fold_changes.csv"),
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ",", na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN"),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
names(fs) <- trimws(names(fs))
fsm <- map_fisher_symbols(fs$gene_id)
fs$FBgn <- fsm$FLYBASE[match(trimws(fs$gene_id), fsm$SYMBOL)]
rule_degs <- function(thr) with(fs, unique(FBgn[!is.na(FBgn) & (
  (!is.na(padj_6.8)   & padj_6.8   < 0.05 & abs(log2FC_6.8)   >= thr) |
  (!is.na(padj_16.18) & padj_16.18 < 0.05 & abs(log2FC_16.18) >= thr))]))
univ_test <- function(degs) {
  cu <- intersect(trh_chip_genes, univ_genes); du <- intersect(degs, univ_genes)
  k <- length(intersect(cu, du)); N <- length(univ_genes); n <- length(cu); K <- length(du)
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(k, n - k, K - k, N - K - n + k), 2, 2))
  list(k = k, K = K, exp = n * K / N, or = unname(ft$estimate), ci = ft$conf.int)
}
dt_049   <- intersect(trh_chip_genes, rule_degs(0.49))
dt_exact <- intersect(trh_chip_genes, rule_degs(log2(1.4)))
stopifnot(all(direct_targets_trh %in% dt_exact), length(direct_targets_trh) == 21L)
u_exact <- univ_test(rule_degs(log2(1.4)))
u_049   <- univ_test(rule_degs(0.49))
cat(sprintf("mapping: %d symbols, %d recovered by synonym/CG, %d unmapped\n",
            nrow(fsm), sum(fsm$route %in% c("alias", "flybasecg")), sum(is.na(fsm$FLYBASE))))
cat(sprintf("targets: reported %d | synonym map, cut 0.49: %d | synonym map, exact 1.4-fold: %d\n",
            length(direct_targets_trh), length(dt_049), length(dt_exact)))
cat("added under the exact 1.4-fold rule:", setdiff(dt_exact, direct_targets_trh), "\n")
save_values("ch5_fisher_mapping", list(
  nFisherAliasRecovered   = sum(fsm$route %in% c("alias", "flybasecg")),
  nFisherUnmapped         = sum(is.na(fsm$FLYBASE)),
  fisherDegLogFcCut       = "0.49",
  nDirectTargetsAliasFix  = length(dt_049),
  nDirectTargetsExactRule = length(dt_exact),
  dtAliasUnivK            = u_049$k,
  dtAliasUnivExpected     = sprintf("%.1f", u_049$exp),
  dtAliasUnivOR           = sprintf("%.2f", u_049$or),
  dtAliasUnivCIlo         = sprintf("%.2f", u_049$ci[1]),
  dtAliasUnivCIhi         = sprintf("%.2f", u_049$ci[2]),
  dtExactUnivK            = u_exact$k,
  dtExactUnivExpected     = sprintf("%.1f", u_exact$exp),
  dtExactUnivOR           = sprintf("%.2f", u_exact$or),
  dtExactUnivCIlo         = sprintf("%.2f", u_exact$ci[1]),
  dtExactUnivCIhi         = sprintf("%.2f", u_exact$ci[2])
))
```



```{r ch5-tissue-filter-21to21, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# Annotates 21-gene direct-target set using 21gene_tissue_annotation.csv.
# Retains gene if Y in trachea, sal_gland or cns_midline; outputs tissue_filtered_21to21.csv.
# Computes nDirectTargetsFiltered/nDirectTargetsExcluded for the ch5-export-computed-values chunk.

# Pre-flight: the 21-gene direct-target set must exist in memory.
stopifnot(exists("direct_targets_trh"))
stopifnot(length(direct_targets_trh) > 0L)

# Path: curator places the CSV in CH5_INPUT_DIR.
P_TISSUE_ANNOT <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, "21gene_tissue_annotation.csv")

if (!file.exists(P_TISSUE_ANNOT)) {
  warning(
    "Tissue annotation CSV not found at:\n  ", P_TISSUE_ANNOT,
    "\nThe tissue-annotation step will be skipped and the retained/excluded\n",
    "counts recorded as NA."
  )
  n_retained_tissue <- NA_integer_
  n_excluded_tissue <- NA_integer_
} else {

  tissue_annot <- read.csv(P_TISSUE_ANNOT, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # ---- Schema and content validation ----
  required_cols <- c("gene_id", "SYMBOL", "trachea", "sal_gland",
                     "cns_midline", "in_bdgp")
  missing_cols  <- setdiff(required_cols, names(tissue_annot))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0L) {
    stop("21gene_tissue_annotation.csv is missing column(s): ",
         paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Coerce Y/N to upper-case and strip whitespace
  yn_cols <- c("trachea", "sal_gland", "cns_midline", "in_bdgp")
  for (col in yn_cols) {
    tissue_annot[[col]] <- toupper(trimws(tissue_annot[[col]]))
  }

  bad_vals <- !unlist(tissue_annot[, yn_cols]) %in% c("Y", "N")
  if (any(bad_vals)) {
    stop("21gene_tissue_annotation.csv contains non-{Y,N} values in ",
         "Y/N columns. Inspect rows: ",
         paste(which(rowSums(
           !sapply(tissue_annot[, yn_cols], `%in%`, c("Y", "N"))
         ) > 0), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Row count must match the 21-gene set exactly.
  if (nrow(tissue_annot) != length(direct_targets_trh)) {
    stop("Row count mismatch: tissue_annot has ", nrow(tissue_annot),
         " rows but direct_targets_trh has ",
         length(direct_targets_trh), " genes.")
  }

  # FBgn set must match the 21-gene set exactly.
  set_in_csv    <- setdiff(tissue_annot$gene_id, direct_targets_trh)
  set_in_direct <- setdiff(direct_targets_trh, tissue_annot$gene_id)
  if (length(set_in_csv) > 0L || length(set_in_direct) > 0L) {
    stop("FBgn set mismatch between 21gene_tissue_annotation.csv and ",
         "the direct-target set.\n",
         "  In CSV but not in direct targets: ",
         paste(set_in_csv, collapse = ", "), "\n",
         "  In direct targets but not in CSV: ",
         paste(set_in_direct, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # ---- Apply filtering rule ----
  tissue_annot$retained <- with(
    tissue_annot,
    ifelse(trachea == "Y" | sal_gland == "Y" | cns_midline == "Y",
           "Y", "N")
  )

  n_retained_tissue <- sum(tissue_annot$retained == "Y")
  n_excluded_tissue <- sum(tissue_annot$retained == "N")

  # ---- Console summary ----
  cat("─── Spatio-temporal filter (22 → 17) ────────────────────\n")
  cat(sprintf("Input direct-target genes:   %d\n",  nrow(tissue_annot)))
  cat(sprintf("Retained (tissue-positive):  %d\n",  n_retained_tissue))
  cat(sprintf("Excluded (tissue-negative):  %d\n",  n_excluded_tissue))

  excluded <- tissue_annot[tissue_annot$retained == "N", ]
  if (nrow(excluded) > 0L) {
    cat("\nExcluded genes (symbol — exclusion reason):\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(excluded))) {
      reason <- if (excluded$in_bdgp[i] == "N") {
        "absent from BDGP database"
      } else {
        "in BDGP but not in queried tissues at stages 11–16"
      }
      cat(sprintf("  %-12s  %s\n", excluded$SYMBOL[i], reason))
    }
  }

  # ---- Export annotated table ----
  P_TISSUE_OUT <- file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "tissue_filtered_21to21.csv")
  write.csv(tissue_annot, P_TISSUE_OUT, row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\nWrote: %s\n", P_TISSUE_OUT))
}
```

```{r ch5-rib-comparison, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ---- Section 5.6: Convergence with Loganathan Rib direct targets ----
# Two-way and three-way overlaps; Fisher's exact tests against the
# dm6-wide gene background.

trh_rib_overlap   <- intersect(direct_targets_trh, rib_target_genes)
n_trh_rib_overlap <- length(trh_rib_overlap)

# 2x2 contingency table for two-way overlap:
#                       | DirectTarget Trh | not |
# RibTarget             |        a         |  b  |
# not RibTarget         |        c         |  d  |
# Universe = all_dm6_genes
a <- n_trh_rib_overlap
b <- length(setdiff(rib_target_genes, direct_targets_trh))
c2 <- length(setdiff(direct_targets_trh, rib_target_genes))
d <- length(all_dm6_genes) - (a + b + c2)

ct_2way <- matrix(c(a, b, c2, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                  dimnames = list(c("Rib_target", "Not_Rib_target"),
                                  c("Trh_target", "Not_Trh_target")))

ft_2way <- fisher.test(ct_2way, alternative = "two.sided")

cat("=== Trh/Tgo direct targets vs Rib direct targets ===\n")
print(ct_2way)
cat(sprintf("\nOR = %.2f, p = %.3g, %d-gene overlap\n",
            unname(ft_2way$estimate), ft_2way$p.value, n_trh_rib_overlap))

# Three-way overlap: Trh-ChIP genes x Fisher DEGs x Rib targets
three_way <- Reduce(intersect, list(trh_chip_genes, fisher_degs,
                                    rib_target_genes))
n_three_way <- length(three_way)
cat("\nThree-way overlap (Trh ChIP x Fisher DEG x Rib target):",
    n_three_way, "gene(s)\n")
if (n_three_way > 0L && n_three_way <= 30L) {
  # Print the gene symbols for inline reference if small
  three_way_sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Dm.eg.db,
                                          keys = three_way,
                                          columns = c("FLYBASE", "SYMBOL"),
                                          keytype = "FLYBASE")
  print(three_way_sym)
}

# Save outputs
write.csv(
  data.frame(FBgn = trh_rib_overlap),
  file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "direct_targets_Trh_Rib_overlap.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  data.frame(FBgn = three_way),
  file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "direct_targets_three_way_overlap.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r ch5-functional-enrichment, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ---- Section 5.5/5.6: GO enrichment on direct-target set ----
# Run on (a) all Trh/Tgo direct targets, (b) Trh-Rib overlap.
# Skipped if clusterProfiler is unavailable or set sizes are too small.

if (requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE) &&
    length(direct_targets_trh) >= 10L) {

  ego_trh <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
    gene          = direct_targets_trh,
    OrgDb         = org.Dm.eg.db,
    keyType       = "FLYBASE",
    ont           = "ALL",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    readable      = TRUE
  )

  if (!is.null(ego_trh) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego_trh)) > 0L) {
    write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_trh),
              file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "GO_TrhTgo_direct_targets.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    cat("GO enrichment on Trh/Tgo direct targets: ",
        nrow(as.data.frame(ego_trh)), " significant terms\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("GO enrichment on Trh/Tgo direct targets: no significant terms\n")
  }

  if (length(trh_rib_overlap) >= 5L) {
    ego_overlap <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
      gene          = trh_rib_overlap,
      OrgDb         = org.Dm.eg.db,
      keyType       = "FLYBASE",
      ont           = "ALL",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      qvalueCutoff  = 0.10,    # relaxed for smaller set
      readable      = TRUE
    )
    if (!is.null(ego_overlap) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego_overlap)) > 0L) {
      write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_overlap),
                file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "GO_Trh_Rib_overlap.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
      cat("GO enrichment on Trh-Rib overlap: ",
          nrow(as.data.frame(ego_overlap)), " significant terms\n",
          sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("GO enrichment on Trh-Rib overlap: no significant terms\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Skipping GO enrichment ",
      "(clusterProfiler not installed or set too small)\n", sep = "")
}
```
