```{r ch5-chung2011-gse28780, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ============================================================
#  Second perturbation axis: Chung, Chavez & Andrew (2011) trh-null
#  microarray (GEO GSE28780, stages 11-16), intersected with Trh/Tgo peaks.
#  Peak-gene mapping: strand-aware nearest-TSS distance, dm6 ensGene.
#  DE: limma, 3 WT vs 3 trh-null, |FC|>=1.4 at p<=0.05; universe = genes with FlyBase ID; hypergeometric test.
#  Result: enrichment restricted to distal peaks (>2kb from TSS); proximal (<=2kb) show none.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GEOquery); library(limma); library(GenomicFeatures)
  library(org.Dm.eg.db); library(AnnotationDbi)
})

CHUNG_FC   <- log2(1.4)            # Chung 2011 fold-change threshold
CHUNG_PMAX <- 0.05                 # Chung 2011 raw-p threshold
TSS_SPLIT  <- 2000L                # proximal/distal boundary (matches ch5 window)

##, 1. Peak -> nearest gene TSS (strand-aware, coordinate-based) ------------
stopifnot(length(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt) == 614L)
jp <- Trh_Tgo_joint_filt
if (is.null(names(jp))) names(jp) <- paste0("peak_", seq_along(jp))
g   <- suppressMessages(genes(txdb))
# Gene ID (FBgn): use gene_id metadata column, always populated.
# names(g) is NULL in some GenomicFeatures builds, giving a
# zero-length column and a "differing number of rows" error.
# Convert GRanges to data.frame in one step.
# Individual accessors fail on some GenomicRanges/S4Vectors
# builds with "S3coerceFUN(from) : not supported".
gdf <- as.data.frame(g)                        # seqnames, start, end, width, strand + mcols
gid_col <- if ("gene_id" %in% names(gdf)) "gene_id" else NULL
if (is.null(gid_col)) {
  # fallback: rownames carry FBgn when names(g) was non-NULL
  gdf$fbgn <- rownames(gdf)
} else {
  gdf$fbgn <- as.character(gdf$gene_id)
}
gdf$chr    <- as.character(gdf$seqnames)
gdf$strand <- as.character(gdf$strand)
gdf$tss    <- ifelse(gdf$strand == "-", gdf$end, gdf$start)
gsplit <- split(gdf, gdf$chr)
nn <- lapply(seq_along(jp), function(i) {
  gi <- gsplit[[ as.character(seqnames(jp)[i]) ]]
  if (is.null(gi) || nrow(gi) == 0)
    return(data.frame(geneId = NA_character_, dist_to_TSS = NA_integer_))
  d <- pmax(start(jp)[i] - gi$tss, gi$tss - end(jp)[i], 0L)
  j <- which.min(d)
  data.frame(geneId = gi$fbgn[j], dist_to_TSS = as.integer(d[j]))
})
chung_pk <- cbind(data.frame(peak = names(jp),
                             start = start(jp), end = end(jp),
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                  do.call(rbind, nn))
saveRDS(chung_pk, file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "trh_tgo_peak_nearest_gene.rds"))

##, 2. GSE28780: fresh limma DE (trh-null vs WT) ----------------------------
options(timeout = 600)
gse28780 <- getGEO("GSE28780", destdir = CH5_OUT_DIR,
                   GSEMatrix = TRUE, getGPL = TRUE)[[1]]
pd28 <- Biobase::pData(gse28780)
fd28 <- Biobase::fData(gse28780)
ex28 <- Biobase::exprs(gse28780)
if (max(ex28, na.rm = TRUE) > 100) ex28 <- log2(ex28 + 1)   # ensure log2 scale
stopifnot(ncol(ex28) == 6L)

chung_grp    <- factor(ifelse(grepl("trh", pd28$title), "trhnull", "WT"),
                       levels = c("WT", "trhnull"))          # 3 WT, 3 trh-null
chung_design <- model.matrix(~ chung_grp)
chung_fit    <- eBayes(lmFit(ex28, chung_design))
chung_tt     <- topTable(chung_fit, coef = "chung_grptrhnull",
                         number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
chung_tt$probe   <- rownames(chung_tt)
chung_tt$entrez1 <- sub(" ?///.*", "", fd28[chung_tt$probe, "ENTREZ_GENE_ID"])
e2fb <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
          org.Dm.eg.db, keys = unique(chung_tt$entrez1[chung_tt$entrez1 != ""]),
          column = "FLYBASE", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first"))
chung_tt$fbgn <- e2fb[chung_tt$entrez1]
chung_ok      <- chung_tt[!is.na(chung_tt$fbgn), ]
saveRDS(chung_tt, file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "gse28780_DE.rds"))

##, 3. Responsive-gene sets and enrichment (proximal vs distal) -------------
chung_universe <- unique(chung_ok$fbgn)

# Direction is assigned per gene, not per probe: each gene is resolved to
# its most significant probe before thresholding, so a gene with one up
# probe and one down probe is not entered into both the `down` and `up`
# sets. This makes the `down` and `up` sets genuinely disjoint, consistent
# with the two being presented as directional opposites. The assertion
# below checks that this holds.
.chung_best <- chung_ok[order(chung_ok$fbgn, chung_ok$P.Value), ]
.chung_best <- .chung_best[!duplicated(.chung_best$fbgn), ]
chung_sets <- list(
  down = .chung_best$fbgn[.chung_best$P.Value <= CHUNG_PMAX &
                          .chung_best$logFC   <= -CHUNG_FC],
  up   = .chung_best$fbgn[.chung_best$P.Value <= CHUNG_PMAX &
                          .chung_best$logFC   >=  CHUNG_FC],
  any  = .chung_best$fbgn[.chung_best$P.Value <= CHUNG_PMAX &
                          abs(.chung_best$logFC) >= CHUNG_FC])
stopifnot(
  length(intersect(chung_sets$down, chung_sets$up)) == 0L,
  length(chung_sets$down) + length(chung_sets$up) == length(chung_sets$any))

# Proximal/distal must be a PARTITION of the bound genes: each gene is
# classified once, by its CLOSEST peak, rather than by class membership of
# each peak followed by de-duplication by gene (which would let a gene
# nearest to both a proximal and a distal peak enter both classes). This
# keeps the two hypergeometric tests below comparing disjoint classes.
.chung_pk_ok <- chung_pk[!is.na(chung_pk$geneId), ]
.chung_min   <- aggregate(dist_to_TSS ~ geneId, data = .chung_pk_ok, FUN = min)
chung_prox  <- .chung_min$geneId[.chung_min$dist_to_TSS <= TSS_SPLIT]
chung_dist  <- .chung_min$geneId[.chung_min$dist_to_TSS >  TSS_SPLIT]
chung_bound <- .chung_min$geneId
stopifnot(
  length(intersect(chung_prox, chung_dist)) == 0L,
  length(chung_prox) + length(chung_dist) == length(chung_bound))

chung_hyper <- function(pgset, deset) {
  pgset <- intersect(pgset, chung_universe)
  deset <- intersect(deset, chung_universe)
  ov    <- intersect(pgset, deset)
  expd  <- length(pgset) * length(deset) / length(chung_universe)
  data.frame(n_peak = length(pgset), n_DE = length(deset), overlap = length(ov),
             expected = expd, fold = length(ov) / expd,
             p = phyper(length(ov) - 1L, length(deset),
                        length(chung_universe) - length(deset),
                        length(pgset), lower.tail = FALSE))
}
chung_enrich <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  list(c("prox","down"),c("prox","up"),c("prox","any"),
       c("dist","down"),c("dist","up"),c("dist","any")),
  function(cc) { r <- chung_hyper(get(paste0("chung_", cc[1])), chung_sets[[cc[2]]])
                 r$loc <- cc[1]; r$set <- cc[2]; r }))
write.csv(chung_enrich[, c("loc","set","n_peak","overlap","expected","fold","p")],
          file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "chung_distal_proximal_enrichment.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
print(chung_enrich[, c("loc","set","overlap","expected","fold","p")])

# High-confidence set: bound and responsive in both Chung and Fisher 2023.
# chung_sets$down is based on Chung fold-change only
chung_conj_any  <- Reduce(intersect, list(chung_bound, fisher_degs, chung_sets$any))
chung_conj_down <- Reduce(intersect, list(chung_bound, fisher_degs, chung_sets$down))
hc <- chung_ok[match(chung_conj_any, chung_ok$fbgn),
               c("fbgn","logFC","P.Value")]
hc$symbol      <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
                    org.Dm.eg.db, keys = hc$fbgn, column = "SYMBOL",
                    keytype = "FLYBASE", multiVals = "first"))
hc$dist_to_TSS <- chung_pk$dist_to_TSS[match(hc$fbgn, chung_pk$geneId)]

##, 4a. Cross-platform DIRECTIONAL concordance ------------------------------
# Fisher direction is taken from the better-supported of the two stage windows
# (smaller BH-adjusted p). `fr` is the Fisher per-gene table built in the
# TEST 2 chunk; if it is not in session, source that chunk first.
stopifnot(exists("fr"))
.fi <- fr[match(hc$fbgn, fr$gene_id), ]
.use68 <- !is.na(.fi$padj_6.8) &
          (is.na(.fi$padj_16.18) | .fi$padj_6.8 <= .fi$padj_16.18)
hc$fisher_log2FC <- ifelse(.use68, .fi$log2FC_6.8, .fi$log2FC_16.18)
hc$fisher_padj   <- ifelse(.use68, .fi$padj_6.8,   .fi$padj_16.18)
hc$concordant    <- sign(hc$logFC) == sign(hc$fisher_log2FC)

n_conj_concordant <- sum(hc$concordant, na.rm = TRUE)
n_conj_discordant <- sum(!hc$concordant, na.rm = TRUE)
# Positional composition of the conjunction set. nConjDistalNovel counts genes
# recoverable only without the +/-2 kb constraint, which for this set is the
# distal subset itself.
n_conj_proximal     <- sum(abs(hc$dist_to_TSS) <= 2000, na.rm = TRUE)
n_conj_distal       <- sum(abs(hc$dist_to_TSS) >  2000, na.rm = TRUE)
n_conj_distal_novel <- n_conj_distal
stopifnot(n_conj_proximal + n_conj_distal == nrow(hc))

hc <- hc[order(!hc$concordant, hc$P.Value), ]   # concordant block first
write.csv(hc, file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "chung_fisher_highconf_targets.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Conjunction: %d genes | directionally concordant %d, discordant %d\n",
            nrow(hc), n_conj_concordant, n_conj_discordant))
cat(sprintf("  discordant: %s\n",
            paste(hc$symbol[!hc$concordant], collapse = ", ")))

##, 4b. Universe-robustness check -------------------------------------------
# Headline enrichment uses all array genes with an FBgn as universe.
# Re-tests against expressed-gene universes at increasing mean log2
# intensity cutoffs. Distal enrichment stays stable; proximal
# enrichment drops further. Range reported in Chapter 5.
chung_ok$meanExpr <- rowMeans(ex28[chung_ok$probe, , drop = FALSE])
chung_gene_expr   <- tapply(chung_ok$meanExpr, chung_ok$fbgn, max)  # gene = brightest probe
chung_robust <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(5, 6, 7), function(cut) {
  uni <- names(chung_gene_expr)[chung_gene_expr >= cut]
  pgd <- intersect(chung_dist, uni); ded <- intersect(chung_sets$any, uni)
  ovd <- intersect(pgd, ded); expd <- length(pgd) * length(ded) / length(uni)
  data.frame(cutoff = cut, n_universe = length(uni),
             dist_fold = length(ovd) / expd,
             dist_p = phyper(length(ovd) - 1L, length(ded),
                             length(uni) - length(ded), length(pgd),
                             lower.tail = FALSE))
}))
write.csv(chung_robust,
          file.path(CH5_OUT_DIR, "chung_universe_robustness.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
print(chung_robust)

##, 5. Convenience scalars for the export chunk -----------------------------
chung_get <- function(loc, set, col)
  chung_enrich[chung_enrich$loc == loc & chung_enrich$set == set, col]
cat(sprintf("Chung GSE28780: universe=%d, bound-on-array=%d (prox=%d, dist=%d)\n",
    length(chung_universe), length(intersect(chung_bound, chung_universe)),
    length(intersect(chung_prox, chung_universe)),
    length(intersect(chung_dist, chung_universe))))
cat(sprintf("Distal responsive fold=%.2f (p=%.2g); proximal fold=%.2f (p=%.2g)\n",
    chung_get("dist","any","fold"), chung_get("dist","any","p"),
    chung_get("prox","any","fold"), chung_get("prox","any","p")))
cat(sprintf("Chung n Fisher conjunction (any/down): %d / %d\n",
    length(chung_conj_any), length(chung_conj_down)))
```

```{r ch5-fig-chung-distal-proximal, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ---- Fig 5.7: distal- vs proximal-peak enrichment for trh-responsiveness ----
# Fold enrichment (observed/expected) of Chung 2011 trh-responsive genes among
# Trh/Tgo target genes, split by peak-to-TSS distance. Uses the shared bar
# chart style (thesis_bar, defined in the setup chunk): contrast-aware in-bar labels, fold + (n/N),
# significance stars spaced above the bars so they never overlap the bar top.
# The significance legend is split across the two panels' top-right slots:
# the n.s. key over the proximal panel, the *** key over the distal panel.
ord    <- c("down","up","any")
setlab <- c(down="Trh-activated\n(down in null)", up="Trh-repressed\n(up in null)",
            any="Any\nresponse")
loc_lab <- c(prox="Proximal peaks (\u2264 2 kb from TSS)",
             dist="Distal peaks (> 2 kb from TSS)")
fills56 <- setNames(unname(PAL_DIRECTION[ord]), setlab[ord])

pdat <- chung_enrich
pdat$xlab  <- factor(setlab[as.character(pdat$set)], levels = setlab[ord])
pdat$panel <- factor(loc_lab[as.character(pdat$loc)], levels = loc_lab)
pdat$Count <- sprintf("(%d/%d)", pdat$overlap, pdat$n_peak)
# In-bar fold value carries an explicit "x" suffix (2.48x = 2.48-fold over
# expected) so the number is unambiguous without mislabelling it as an or.
pdat$Fold  <- sprintf("%.2f\u00d7", pdat$fold)
pdat$Sig   <- thesis_stars(pdat$p)
# Split significance legend: proximal slot -> n.s. key; distal slot -> *** key.
# The distal panel contains a non-significant bar too (trh-activated), so its
# key must cover both symbols, otherwise the panel has no legend entry for
# one of its own bars.
pdat$Nlab  <- ifelse(pdat$loc == "prox", "n.s. - not significant",
                     "*** p < 1e-3;  n.s. - not significant")

p <- thesis_bar(pdat, x = "xlab", y = "fold", fill = "xlab",
                value = "Fold", count = "Count", sig = "Sig",
                facet = "panel", n_lab = "Nlab", n_lab_size = 4.4, fills = fills56,
                y_max = 3.35, dashed_at = 1,
                y_lab = "Fold enrichment (observed / expected)")
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig5_6_chung_distal_proximal.png"), p,
       width = 8.3, height = 4.8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("Wrote fig5_6_chung_distal_proximal.png\n")
```

```{r ch5-test2-motif2-perturbation, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ============================================================
#  Test 2: does Motif2 (STRCACTGARARAAA) at Trh/Tgo peaks predict transcriptional response to trh knockdown (Fisher et al. 2023 modERN RNA-seq)
#  Motif2 hits from FIMO scan (fimo_joint/fimo.tsv, q<=0.05); peak-gene assignment by strand-aware nearest TSS (dm6 ensGene), split proximal <=2kb vs distal >2kb
#  Outcome: |log2FC| at 6-8h window. Inputs: Trh_Tgo_joint_filt (614 peaks), REFERENCE_LISTS/Fisher2023_per_gene_fold_changes.csv
#  Result: null in all framings, including the distal set
# ============================================================
suppressMessages({
  library(GenomicRanges); library(rtracklayer); library(ggplot2)
  library(TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene); library(org.Dm.eg.db)
})
stopifnot(exists("Trh_Tgo_joint_filt"), length(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt) == 614L)
txdb <- TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene

##, 1. Motif2 flag per peak (canonical peak_N -> coordinate mapping) --------
# FIMO joint-peak scan produced by the Chapter 3 analysis (data/chapter3).
P_FIMO_JOINT <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data", "chapter3",
                          "fimo_joint", "fimo.tsv")
stopifnot(file.exists(P_FIMO_JOINT))
fimo <- read.delim(P_FIMO_JOINT, comment.char = "#", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
fimo <- fimo[fimo$motif_id == "STRCACTGARARAAA" &
             !is.na(fimo$q.value) & fimo$q.value <= 0.05, ]
pidx <- as.integer(sub("peak_", "", fimo$sequence_name))
stopifnot(all(pidx >= 1L & pidx <= length(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)))
# peak-local start/stop (1-based within-peak) -> genomic coordinate
fimo_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = as.character(seqnames(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt))[pidx],
  ranges   = IRanges(start(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)[pidx] + fimo$start - 1L,
                     start(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)[pidx] + fimo$stop  - 1L)
)
has_motif2 <- countOverlaps(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt, fimo_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE) > 0
mcols(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)$has_motif2 <- has_motif2
n_peaks_m2 <- sum(has_motif2)
cat(sprintf("Motif2 (q<=0.05) present at %d / %d peaks (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_peaks_m2, length(has_motif2), 100 * mean(has_motif2)))

##, 2. Strand-aware nearest-TSS (dm6 ensGene), coordinate-based --------------
g   <- suppressMessages(as.data.frame(genes(txdb)))
g   <- g[as.character(g$seqnames) %in% good_chr, ]
tss <- ifelse(g$strand == "+", g$start, g$end)
tss_gr <- GRanges(g$seqnames, IRanges(tss, tss),
                  strand = g$strand, gene_id = g$gene_id)
nr <- distanceToNearest(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt, tss_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
pk <- data.frame(
  gene_id    = tss_gr$gene_id[subjectHits(nr)],
  dist       = mcols(nr)$distance,
  signal     = Trh_Tgo_joint_filt$signalValue[queryHits(nr)],
  has_motif2 = mcols(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)$has_motif2[queryHits(nr)],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

##, 3. Fisher per-gene fold change, symbol -> FBgn (Chapter 5 recipe) --------
P_FISHER_PG <- file.path(REFERENCE_LISTS, "Fisher2023_per_gene_fold_changes.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(P_FISHER_PG))
fr <- read.delim(P_FISHER_PG, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ",",
                 na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN"),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
names(fr) <- trimws(names(fr))
names(fr)[names(fr) == "gene_id"] <- "symbol_fisher"
fr$symbol_fisher <- trimws(fr$symbol_fisher)
## Same symbol -> FBgn mapping as the direct-target table (map_fisher_symbols()).
mp <- map_fisher_symbols(fr$symbol_fisher)
mp <- mp[!is.na(mp$FLYBASE), c("SYMBOL", "FLYBASE")]
fr$gene_id <- mp$FLYBASE[match(fr$symbol_fisher, mp$SYMBOL)]
fr <- fr[!is.na(fr$gene_id), ]
fr$min_padj <- pmin(fr$padj_6.8, fr$padj_16.18, na.rm = TRUE)
fr <- fr[order(fr$gene_id, fr$min_padj), ]
fr <- fr[!duplicated(fr$gene_id), ]

##, 4. Per-gene stratum table and the tests ---------------------------------
# Collapse peaks to genes within a distance band: a gene is Motif2-positive
# if any assigned peak carries Motif2; strongest peak signal is retained.
build_stratum <- function(dist_lo, dist_hi, label) {
  s  <- pk[pk$dist >= dist_lo & pk$dist <= dist_hi, ]
  gm <- tapply(s$has_motif2, s$gene_id, any)
  gs <- tapply(s$signal,     s$gene_id, max)
  d  <- data.frame(gene_id     = names(gm),
                   has_motif2  = as.logical(gm),
                   peak_signal = as.numeric(gs[names(gm)]),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  d  <- merge(d, fr[, c("gene_id", "log2FC_6.8", "log2FC_16.18")],
              by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
  d  <- d[!is.na(d$log2FC_6.8), ]
  d$abs68   <- abs(d$log2FC_6.8)
  d$abs1618 <- abs(d$log2FC_16.18)
  d$stratum <- label
  d
}
d_prox <- build_stratum(0L,    2000L, "Proximal (\u2264 2 kb)")
d_dist <- build_stratum(2001L, Inf,   "Distal (> 2 kb)")
d_all  <- build_stratum(0L,    Inf,   "All peaks")

test2_wilcox <- function(d, col = "abs68") {
  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(d[[col]] ~ d$has_motif2))
  list(p = unname(w$p.value),
       med_pos = median(d[[col]][d$has_motif2]),
       med_neg = median(d[[col]][!d$has_motif2]),
       n_pos = sum(d$has_motif2), n_neg = sum(!d$has_motif2))
}
r_prox <- test2_wilcox(d_prox)
r_dist <- test2_wilcox(d_dist)
r_all  <- test2_wilcox(d_all)

# Robustness: signal-controlled regression on the pooled set (proximal +
# distal). Does Motif2 add predictive power for |log2FC| once peak signal
# strength is accounted for?
d_reg <- d_all
d_reg$log_signal <- log10(d_reg$peak_signal)
fit_full <- lm(abs68 ~ log_signal + has_motif2, data = d_reg)
fit_red  <- lm(abs68 ~ log_signal,              data = d_reg)
lm_p <- anova(fit_red, fit_full)$`Pr(>F)`[2]
lm_beta <- summary(fit_full)$coefficients["has_motif2TRUE", "Estimate"]

cat("\n== TEST 2: Motif2 vs trh-RNAi |log2FC| (6-8 h) ==\n")
cat(sprintf("  Proximal:  n+=%d n-=%d  med+=%.3f med-=%.3f  Wilcoxon p=%.3f\n",
            r_prox$n_pos, r_prox$n_neg, r_prox$med_pos, r_prox$med_neg, r_prox$p))
cat(sprintf("  Distal:    n+=%d n-=%d  med+=%.3f med-=%.3f  Wilcoxon p=%.3f\n",
            r_dist$n_pos, r_dist$n_neg, r_dist$med_pos, r_dist$med_neg, r_dist$p))
cat(sprintf("  All peaks: n+=%d n-=%d  med+=%.3f med-=%.3f  Wilcoxon p=%.3f\n",
            r_all$n_pos, r_all$n_neg, r_all$med_pos, r_all$med_neg, r_all$p))
cat(sprintf("  Signal-controlled lm: motif2 beta=%.4f  partial-F p=%.3f\n",
            lm_beta, lm_p))

##, 5. Figure: proximal/distal boxplots, |log2FC| by Motif2 status ----------
D <- rbind(d_prox, d_dist)
D$grp     <- factor(ifelse(D$has_motif2, "Motif2-positive", "Motif2-negative"),
                    levels = c("Motif2-negative", "Motif2-positive"))
D$stratum <- factor(D$stratum, levels = c("Proximal (\u2264 2 kb)", "Distal (> 2 kb)"))
pv <- c("Proximal (\u2264 2 kb)" = r_prox$p, "Distal (> 2 kb)" = r_dist$p)
ytop <- as.numeric(quantile(D$abs68, 0.99))
lab_df <- data.frame(stratum = factor(names(pv), levels = levels(D$stratum)),
                     lab = sprintf("Wilcoxon~italic(p)==%.2f", pv))
ns <- aggregate(abs68 ~ stratum + grp, D, length); names(ns)[3] <- "n"

p <- ggplot(D, aes(grp, abs68, fill = grp)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ stratum) +
  geom_text(data = ns, aes(x = grp, label = paste0("n=", n), y = -0.03),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, colour = PAL_INK[["annotation"]]) +
  geom_text(data = lab_df, aes(x = 1.5, y = ytop * 1.08, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.4, parse = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_binary("Motif2-positive", "Motif2-negative"),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = expression(group("|", log[2]~"fold change", "|")~"  ("*italic("trh")*"-RNAi, 6-8 h)")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.06, ytop * 1.15)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = PAL_INK[["band"]]),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## Figure height is 4.25 in, giving a slightly larger label size at \linewidth
## than a taller figure would.
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig5_7_motif2_perturbation.png"),
       plot = p, width = 8, height = 4.25, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("Wrote fig5_7_motif2_perturbation.png\n")

##, 6. Convenience scalars for the export chunk -----------------------------
# Consumed by ch5-export-computed-values (see the TEST 2 block added to ch5_vals).
test2_n_peaks_motif2  <- n_peaks_m2
test2_prox_p          <- r_prox$p
test2_prox_med_pos    <- r_prox$med_pos
test2_prox_med_neg    <- r_prox$med_neg
test2_prox_n_pos      <- r_prox$n_pos
test2_prox_n_neg      <- r_prox$n_neg
test2_dist_p          <- r_dist$p
test2_dist_med_pos    <- r_dist$med_pos
test2_dist_med_neg    <- r_dist$med_neg
test2_dist_n_pos      <- r_dist$n_pos
test2_dist_n_neg      <- r_dist$n_neg
test2_all_p           <- r_all$p
test2_lm_p            <- lm_p
```

```{r ch5-test2-power-and-cme-control, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# ============================================================
#  TEST 2 ADDENDUM: MINIMUM DETECTABLE EFFECT AND CME POSITIVE CONTROL
#  (a) MDE via Noether normal approximation for Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney,
#      AUC scale, two-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.80.
#  (b) E-box (ACGTG, either strand) substituted for Motif2 as predictor
#      of |log2FC|, same pipeline.
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(BSgenome.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6); library(Biostrings)
})
stopifnot(exists("Trh_Tgo_joint_filt"), length(Trh_Tgo_joint_filt) == 614L,
          exists("pk"), exists("fr"))

##, 1. CME flag per peak: ACGTG on either strand (Chapter 3 definition) -----
.seqs   <- getSeq(BSgenome.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6, Trh_Tgo_joint_filt)
has_cme <- vcountPattern("ACGTG", .seqs) > 0 |
           vcountPattern("CACGT", .seqs) > 0        # revcomp of ACGTG
# Check: must reproduce the Chapter 3 CME-positive count exactly.
stopifnot(sum(has_cme) == 186L)
pk$has_cme <- has_cme[queryHits(distanceToNearest(
  Trh_Tgo_joint_filt,
  { .g <- suppressMessages(as.data.frame(genes(txdb)))
    .g <- .g[as.character(.g$seqnames) %in% good_chr, ]
    GRanges(.g$seqnames,
            IRanges(ifelse(.g$strand == "+", .g$start, .g$end),
                    ifelse(.g$strand == "+", .g$start, .g$end)),
            strand = .g$strand) },
  ignore.strand = TRUE))]

##, 2. Generalised stratum builder (flag column by name) --------------------
build_flag <- function(dist_lo, dist_hi, flagcol) {
  s  <- pk[pk$dist >= dist_lo & pk$dist <= dist_hi, ]
  gm <- tapply(s[[flagcol]], s$gene_id, any)
  gs <- tapply(s$signal,     s$gene_id, max)
  d  <- data.frame(gene_id = names(gm), flag = as.logical(gm),
                   peak_signal = as.numeric(gs[names(gm)]),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  d  <- merge(d, fr[, c("gene_id", "log2FC_6.8")], by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
  d  <- d[!is.na(d$log2FC_6.8), ]
  d$abs68 <- abs(d$log2FC_6.8)
  d
}

##, 3. MDE (Noether) and observed AUC ---------------------------------------
mde_auc <- function(n1, n2, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80)
  0.5 + (qnorm(1 - alpha/2) + qnorm(power)) / sqrt(12 * n1 * n2 / (n1 + n2))
auc_obs <- function(x, y) {
  r <- rank(c(x, y))
  (sum(r[seq_along(x)]) - length(x) * (length(x) + 1) / 2) / (length(x) * length(y))
}
summarise_flag <- function(d) {
  x <- d$abs68[d$flag]; y <- d$abs68[!d$flag]
  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y))
  list(n_pos = length(x), n_neg = length(y),
       med_pos = median(x), med_neg = median(y), p = unname(w$p.value),
       auc = auc_obs(x, y), mde = mde_auc(length(x), length(y)))
}

t2_m2_prox <- summarise_flag(build_flag(0L,    2000L, "has_motif2"))
t2_m2_dist <- summarise_flag(build_flag(2001L, Inf,   "has_motif2"))
t2_m2_all  <- summarise_flag(build_flag(0L,    Inf,   "has_motif2"))
t2_cme_prox <- summarise_flag(build_flag(0L,    2000L, "has_cme"))
t2_cme_dist <- summarise_flag(build_flag(2001L, Inf,   "has_cme"))
t2_cme_all  <- summarise_flag(build_flag(0L,    Inf,   "has_cme"))

# Check: Motif2 group sizes must reproduce the values already in the chapter.
stopifnot(t2_m2_prox$n_pos == 85L, t2_m2_prox$n_neg == 340L,
          t2_m2_dist$n_pos == 71L, t2_m2_dist$n_neg == 53L)

cat("\n== TEST 2 ADDENDUM: MDE and CME positive control ==\n")
for (nm in c("t2_m2_prox","t2_m2_dist","t2_m2_all",
             "t2_cme_prox","t2_cme_dist","t2_cme_all")) {
  r <- get(nm)
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s n+=%3d n-=%3d  p=%.3f  AUC=%.3f  MDE(80%%)=%.3f\n",
              nm, r$n_pos, r$n_neg, r$p, r$auc, r$mde))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Appendix figures for Chapter 5 microarray QC
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Two 3+2 tiles  (Limma_fdr, stdev_vs_mean), single-panel inputs only.
# Ten individual stage PNGs (SampleBoxplot, MAplotsp1), copy through unchanged.
# ============================================================

# Directory holding the FlyChip microarray QC images R{11-15}.vsn.*.png.
#
# These files are inputs to the tiles and copies composed from them, so they
# are kept with the other Chapter 5 inputs rather than in FIGURES_DIR.
MARRAY_QC_PNG_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "data", "chapter5",
                                   "microarray_qc_images")
if (!dir.exists(MARRAY_QC_PNG_DIR))
  stop("missing microarray QC image directory ", MARRAY_QC_PNG_DIR,
       " -- the 20 R{11-15}.vsn.{Limma.fdr,stdev_vs_mean,",
       "Sample-Boxplot,MAplots-p1}.png files are there")
.need <- file.path(MARRAY_QC_PNG_DIR,
                   sprintf("R%d.vsn.%s.png", rep(11:15, 4),
                           rep(c("Limma.fdr", "stdev_vs_mean",
                                 "Sample-Boxplot", "MAplots-p1"), each = 5)))
if (any(!file.exists(.need)))
  stop("missing microarray QC image(s):\n  ",
       paste(basename(.need[!file.exists(.need)]), collapse = "\n  "))

# ---- Helper: 3+2 tile (only safe for single-panel input PNGs) ----
make_tile_3_2 <- function(panel_paths, out_path) {
  stopifnot(length(panel_paths) == 5)
  missing <- panel_paths[!file.exists(panel_paths)]
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop("Missing source PNG(s):\n  ", paste(missing, collapse = "\n  "))
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("magick", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Install the 'magick' R package: install.packages('magick')")
  }
  imgs   <- magick::image_read(panel_paths)
  w      <- magick::image_info(imgs[1])$width
  h      <- magick::image_info(imgs[1])$height
  filler <- magick::image_blank(w, h, color = "white")
  top    <- magick::image_append(imgs[1:3])
  bottom <- magick::image_append(c(imgs[4:5], filler))
  magick::image_write(magick::image_append(c(top, bottom), stack = TRUE),
                      path = out_path, format = "png")
  invisible(out_path)
}

# ---- (1) Two tiles ----
tile_specs <- list(
  list(stem = "Limma.fdr",     out = "figH_1_volcano_st11to15.png"),
  list(stem = "stdev_vs_mean", out = "figH_2_meanvar_st11to15.png")
)

for (spec in tile_specs) {
  src <- file.path(MARRAY_QC_PNG_DIR,
                   sprintf("R%d.vsn.%s.png", 11:15, spec$stem))
  out <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, spec$out)
  make_tile_3_2(src, out)
  message("Wrote tile: ", out)
}

# ---- (2) Individual per-stage figures (no resampling, just copy) ----
## The appendix figure index and the stage are derived together here:
## boxplots are H.8-H.12 for stages 11-15, MA-plots H.3-H.7.
individual_specs <- list(
  list(stem = "Sample-Boxplot", off = -3L, out_fmt = "figH_%d_boxplot_norm_st%d.png"),
  list(stem = "MAplots-p1",     off = -8L, out_fmt = "figH_%d_maplot_st%d.png")
)

for (spec in individual_specs) {
  for (s in 11:15) {
    src <- file.path(MARRAY_QC_PNG_DIR,
                     sprintf("R%d.vsn.%s.png", s, spec$stem))
    out <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, sprintf(spec$out_fmt, s + spec$off, s))
    stopifnot(file.exists(src))
    file.copy(src, out, overwrite = TRUE)
    message("Copied: ", out)
  }
}

old_tile <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig5_app_lm_diag.png")
if (file.exists(old_tile)) file.remove(old_tile)
```

```{r ch5-fig-app-lm-diag, eval=FALSE}
# ============================================================
#  Per-stage lm diagnostics (plot.lm) for lm(microarray ~ RTqPCR), all 16 validation genes, stages 11-15; outputs figJ_1_lm_diag_st11..st15.png; standalone, loads project paths; data as Figure 5.5 (R{st}.vsn.limma.fdr.txt.gz by TargetID, st{st}_validation_unstacked.csv)
# ============================================================
if (!exists("FIGURES_DIR"))
CH5_INPUT_DIR <- CH5_DIR          # data/chapter5 (limma + RT-qPCR)
LIMMA_DIR     <- CH5_INPUT_DIR
stopifnot(dir.exists(CH5_INPUT_DIR), dir.exists(FIGURES_DIR))

stage_ids <- 11:15

# 16 validation genes, identified by microarray probe (TargetID), single
# source of truth linking RT-qPCR gene names to limma probe rows.
probe_map <- c(
  "BicC"     = "CG4824-RA",  "PGRP-SB1" = "CG9681-RA",  "Cyp6a19" = "CG10243-RA",
  "dhd"      = "CG4193-RA",  "AsnS"     = "CG33486-RA", "Ect3"    = "CG3132-RA",
  "Phk-3"    = "CG9358-RA",  "Cpr51A"   = "CG10112-RA", "trh"     = "CG6883-RA",
  "Cyp12a4"  = "CG6042-RA",  "Cyp309a2" = "CG18559-RA", "ninaD"   = "CG31783-RA",
  "CG14102"  = "CG14102-RA", "Cdc42"    = "CG12530-RB", "Sli"     = "CG8355-RC",
  "Ir7b"     = "CG15326-RA"
)

read_marray_stage <- function(st) {
  f <- file.path(LIMMA_DIR, sprintf("R%d.vsn.limma.fdr.txt.gz", st))
  stopifnot(file.exists(f))
  lim <- read.delim(f, skip = 1, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(c("TargetID", "logFC", "t") %in% names(lim)))
  idx <- match(probe_map, lim$TargetID)
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(idx)))
  data.frame(gene = names(probe_map),
             microarray = as.numeric(lim$logFC[idx]),
             row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

read_rtqpcr_stage <- function(st) {
  f <- file.path(CH5_INPUT_DIR, sprintf("st%d_validation_unstacked.csv", st))
  stopifnot(file.exists(f))
  d <- read.csv(f, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
  names(d)[names(d) %in% c("RT-qPCR", "RT.qPCR")] <- "RTqPCR"
  data.frame(gene = rownames(d), RTqPCR = as.numeric(d$RTqPCR),
             row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

for (st in stage_ids) {
  d <- merge(read_marray_stage(st), read_rtqpcr_stage(st), by = "gene")
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == 16L)                      # all 16 genes, no exclusions
  fit <- lm(microarray ~ RTqPCR, data = d)

  # NAMING: figures are written as "figJ_{1..5}_lm_diag_st{11..15}.png".
  # The panel index and the stage are both derived together here, so the
  # numbering in the filename stays consistent with the stage being plotted.
  out <- file.path(FIGURES_DIR,
                   sprintf("figJ_%d_lm_diag_st%d.png", st - 10L, st))
  png(out, width = 8, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
  op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2.6, 1.2), oma = c(0, 0, 2.2, 0))
  # Panels 1,2,3,5 = residual-fitted, normal Q-Q, scale-location, residual-leverage
  # (not which=1:4, which would give Cook's distance instead of residual-leverage).
  plot(fit, which = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 5L), sub.caption = "")  # suppress default formula caption
  mtext(sprintf("Stage %d  (n = %d, all 16 validation genes)", st, nrow(d)),
        outer = TRUE, cex = 1.0, font = 2)
  par(op)
  dev.off()
  cat(sprintf("Wrote %s\n", out))
}
```

```{r ch5-export-computed-values, eval=FALSE}
  signConcordGwStFourteen        = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * stat14$mid$sign_concord),
  nValidatedStThirteen           = length(valid_st13),
  nValidatedStFourteen           = length(valid_st14),
  nValidatedUnion                = length(union(valid_st13, valid_st14)),
  nValidatedIntersection         = length(intersect(valid_st13, valid_st14)),
  signConcordValidatedStThirteen = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * sign_c_valid_st13),
  signConcordValidatedStFourteen = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * sign_c_valid_st14),

  # ---- Direct targets, RT-qPCR, Rib comparison (was strip-append block) ----
  nFisherDegs                    = length(fisher_degs),
  nMarrayValidated               = marray_validated_total,
  nMarrayInFisher                = marray_in_fisher_total,
  pctMarrayInFisher              = round(100 * marray_in_fisher_total / marray_validated_total, 1),
  marrayDataSource               = marray_source,
  ##, trh knock-down efficacy, RT-qPCR (the efficacy measurement) -----------
  trhQpcrStEleven       = sprintf("%.2f", trh_qpcr$log2FC[1]),
  trhQpcrStTwelve       = sprintf("%.2f", trh_qpcr$log2FC[2]),
  trhQpcrStThirteen     = sprintf("%.2f", trh_qpcr$log2FC[3]),
  trhQpcrStFourteen     = sprintf("%.2f", trh_qpcr$log2FC[4]),
  trhQpcrStFifteen      = sprintf("%.2f", trh_qpcr$log2FC[5]),
  trhQpcrFoldStFifteen  = sprintf("%.1f", 1 / 2^trh_qpcr$log2FC[5]),
  trhQpcrFoldStFourteen = sprintf("%.1f", 1 / 2^trh_qpcr$log2FC[4]),
  # Stage-agnostic: the deepest depletion and the stage at which it occurs are
  # derived from the data, never asserted, so trhQpcrFoldStFifteen is not used
  # to state "the deepest" anywhere.
  trhQpcrFoldMax        = sprintf("%.2f", 1 / 2^min(trh_qpcr$log2FC)),
  trhQpcrStageMax       = sprintf("%d",   trh_qpcr$stage[which.min(trh_qpcr$log2FC)]),
  trhQpcrRho            = sprintf("%.2f", unname(ct_stage$estimate)),
  trhQpcrRhoP           = sprintf("%.3f", ct_stage$p.value),
  # Per-stage inference is possible because the raw Ct workbook carries three
  # independent preparations per arm per stage.
  trhQpcrPStThirteen    = sprintf("%.3f", trh_qpcr$p_welch[3]),
  trhQpcrPMinOther      = sprintf("%.2f", min(trh_qpcr$p_welch[-3])),
  trhQpcrPermStThirteen = sprintf("%.2f", trh_qpcr$p_perm[3]),

  ##, trh on the array (secondary trace; not the efficacy claim) ------------
  trhArrayStEleven      = sprintf("%+.2f", trh_array$log2FC[1]),
```
